articleTitle: Application of the YOLOv8 Model to a Fruit Picking Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Due to the current labor shortage in fruit picking, the utilization of robots for harvesting has become crucial in addressing this issue. This paper presents two key models, an apple image recognition model and an apple image recognition classification model, both based on Yolov8. These models are specifically designed and trained to be implemented in apple picking robots. In Model1, the RGB color space was chosen, and the image data underwent preprocessing using Gaussian filtering. The training process utilized manually labeled data. Model 2, on the other hand, involved data grouping and training using the Yolov8 model, with a focus on optimizing the recognition results. The feasibility of these models was rigorously tested through extensive modeling experiments. This research not only offers a solution for the labor shortage in fruit picking robots but also demonstrates its wide-ranging potential in real-life applications and sales processes. Furthermore, the insights gained from this study can contribute to the advancement of automatic recognition and classification of other fruits, thereby fostering the intelligent development of fruit picking robots.

articleTitle: UAV Target Tracking and Detection Based on Faster R-CNN Improved Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the arrival of the computer intelligence era, human requirements for industrial automation and intelligence are becoming more and more urgent, this paper mainly relies on the UAV platform to explore the performance advantages and disadvantages of the optimized and improved hrnet as the backbone network of Faster R-CNN in the field of target tracking. The study provides a new algorithmic idea for the future application of target tracking and detection in the field of industrial automation. The experimental results show that the network has improved mAP, Parameters/M, and FPS compared to Faster R-CNN (RESNET50), SSD (VGG), YOLOv3 (Darknet53), and YOLOv8 (EfficientNet-B0). The improved network can accurately track and segment the target in cases where the UAV flies at variable altitude and the target presents multi-scale features. It can be seen that the Faster R-CNN (hrnet) network has good target tracking and detection ability and high robustness, which makes the UAV more valuable in the application fields of logistics and transportation, film and television shooting, environmental monitoring, and emergency rescue.

articleTitle: Computing Resources Monitoring and Task Scheduling Design for Targeting a Massive Patent Data Fusion Cluster
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the maturity of cloud computing and distributed computing theory, the fusion of massive patent data increasingly relies on distributed clusters to efficiently process data. A simple system monitoring and data processing system is difficult to effectively improve the stability and resource utilization efficiency of the entire cluster. This article combines the monitoring subsystem and data processing subsystem to design a task scheduling capability with negative feedback regulation for the entire cluster, which can significantly reduce the probability of system crashes caused by resource depletion, improve the efficiency of computing resource utilization, and reduce operation and maintenance costs.

articleTitle: Research on Development and Application of AI Agent for Travel Recommendation Driven by Large Language Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Based on the large language model and ZeLinAI platform, the construction and application of travel recommendation AI agents are carried out. And the deep learning and sentiment analysis methods of the large model are integrated to further explore the needs of users, provide users with more accurate and personalized travel recommendation services, and continuously optimize travel recommendation AI agents by optimizing prompt and introducing custom training sets.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Warning System for Insurance Company Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the rapid increase of data in the insurance industry, traditional risk assessment methods are facing limitations, while neural network technology has attracted much attention because of its powerful pattern recognition ability. In this paper, RBF neural network is used to improve the accuracy and efficiency of risk prediction of insurance companies. Through data acquisition and cleaning to ensure data quality, we extract and select features to identify key risk factors. We design and implement the RBF neural network model, including determining the network structure and parameter settings. Finally, the system performance is evaluated by model training and testing. The results show that the accuracy of the constructed model reaches 95. 2% on the training set and 92. 8% on the test set, showing good generalization ability and risk prediction effect. This study provides an effective risk management tool for insurance companies, which helps to optimize risk control strategies and improve the quality of insurance services.

articleTitle: User Attribute Identification Based on Load Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The distribution of business entities in business districts is of great significance to the profile of urban consumption vitality. However, in the power system, a large number of business district electricity users are defined as “property management” attributes, and it is impossible to accurately divide the business entities to which users belong. Based on the files and load data of electricity users in the business district, this article carries out a business entity identification analysis of electricity users in the business district. It uses the business district list on the Baidu map platform to map to the electricity users in the power system to complete the collection of files and load data of electricity users in the business district. Through data processing, load derived indicators are designed, and a feature matrix is constructed to form an input data set. The K-means cluster analysis model is constructed to identify the business entity attributes of “property management” users and accurately divide them into: hotels, office buildings, shopping malls and complexes.

articleTitle: Design of a Six Degrees of Freedom Robotic Arm for Grasping Flat Objects Based on Bus Servo Drive
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: There are many common flat objects in life, such as plastic pieces on the beach, chess cards on the desktop, and tiny parts in industrial production, that have low surface friction, which is a challenge for traditional manipulator grasping. Therefore, this study proposes a design of a manipulator suitable for grasping flat objects of different sizes, shapes, and materials, aiming to improve the accuracy and adaptability of grasping technology and to increase efficiency in production and daily life. The method used to grasp flat objects in this study is “shoveling”, which means that the manipulator has two fingers. One finger is used to fix the side of the object, and the other finger shovels the object from the bottom and completes the clamping. The essence of the mechanical claw finger structure is that the servo drives the rack and pinion to make the finger stretch up and down, while the whole mechanical claw structure will be mounted on the robotic arm for control, and all the programs are executed by the Arduino control board. Through the eight sizes, shapes, and materials of different items for the grasping test, it was found that the mechanical claw for most of the flat objects has a strong adaptability. Compared with traditional grippers, this project has a simpler structure, lower material cost, and higher stability.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Universal Bootloader Upper Computer Based on 698 Protocol
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper deeply discusses the construction method of general Bootloader upper computer based on 698 protocol, aiming at improving the upgrade efficiency and stability of power equipment. In embedded system, Bootloader as the key component of system startup, its importance is self-evident. This paper puts forward an innovative design scheme, based on the State grid object-oriented 698 protocol, using LabView development platform, to build a general Bootloader upper computer. In order to ensure the reliability and stability of the upgrade, the scheme also introduces the code backup and program verification mechanism. The experimental results show that the success rate of the embedded system upgrade is significantly improved by using the Bootloader. The research results provide a new solution for the stable operation and equipment upgrade of the power system, which is of great significance for promoting the upgrading of the power industry.

articleTitle: Design Scheme of Network Security Access System Based on Zero Trust
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The issue of security in the process of digitalization of state-owned enterprises is becoming increasingly prominent. Due to the security issues inherent in security boundary protection devices themselves, traditional security solutions are finding it difficult to address the overall problem of network security. This paper proposes a network security access system design scheme based on zero trust. It uses cryptographic technology to perform user identity marking and authentication, preventing interception and reuse of user password information. Cryptographic technology ensures the confidentiality and integrity of critical data during transmission and storage, preventing data leakage or tampering. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed scheme are verified through its actual application in Beitou Cloud.

articleTitle: Simulation and Verification of Common Mode Voltage in EDS
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Common mode voltage is a critical parameter that must be suppressed in electric drive systems. It not only affects electromagnetic disturbance test results but also poses significant risks to bearing corrosion and overall reliability. Research on the generation mechanism of common mode voltage and its verification are prerequisites for effectively suppressing common mode voltage. This paper analyzes the generation mechanism of common mode voltage and conducts experiments to study and verify common mode voltage models under different working conditions.

articleTitle: The Research of a Model-Based Derivative Alarm Identification Method for Civil Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the widely application of new product and new technology, the cross-linking relationship between civil aircraft systems are becoming more and more complex. When one system fails internally, other systems may also come to failures due to the cross-linking relationship between the systems, eventually triggering multiple crew alarms in the cockpit and causing trouble to the crew. Therefore, how to accurately identify the triggered alarm in the cockpit has become a difficulty in the alarm design of civil aircraft crews. This article proposes a model-based derived alarm identification method for civil aircraft, which can accurately identify alarms in the triggering state in the cockpit, help designers quickly analyze and design cross-system derived alarms, and avoid multiple alarms being triggered at the same time, which may cause consequences to the crew.

articleTitle: Analysis of Error Rate of Residual Current Electrical Fire Monitoring Detector by Capacitive Impedance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In recent years, electrical fire accidents occur frequently, and the residual current electrical fire monitoring system has a large error because it cannot filter the capacitive current component effectively. Thus, in view of the shortcomings of existing residual current monitoring systems, this paper first analyses the working principle of residual current detection. Then, in order to analyze the effect of capacitive impedance on the error rate of residual current electrical fire monitoring detector, this paper measured the data of the ordinary type and the resistive-capacitive separated type residual current electrical fire monitoring detectors by constructing a residual current accurate reproduction test platform and adjusting the capacitive impedance ratio and residual current test level. The effect on the error rate of residual current type electrical fire monitoring detectors under different residual current values and capacitive impedance ratios is revealed. The change trend is obtained by the nonlinear fitting curve to provide data support for the subsequent study, so as to filter out the effect of the capacitive current component on the residual current electrical fire monitoring detector.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Battery System Simulation Platform Based on Computer BMS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Battery management system plays a very important role in new energy pure electric vehicles. At present, there are many problems in the integrated system composed of multiple modules in new energy pure electric vehicles, and the CAN bus communication between each control unit is complicated and lagging. In this paper, the CANoe/MATLAB collaborative simulation method is used to carry out experimental research. Firstly, based on MATLAB/Simulink simulation, the multi-module communication mode is constructed, and the interaction relationship between the modules is analyzed. Secondly, the multi-module communication architecture based on CAN bus is constructed, and the realtime accuracy of communication between modules is verified. The experiment proves that CANoe/MATLAB collaborative simulation can easily design a communication strategy suitable for distributed battery management system.

articleTitle: Design of Campus Security Information Identification System Based on ZigBee and CC2530 Module
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the development of information technology, more and more big data and Internet of Things related technologies have begun to integrate into the construction of campus information, and the construction of campus security information identification system is developing in the direction of automatic, intelligent, sharing and linkage. In this study, the intelligent campus security information needs are investigated, and the campus security system based on the Internet of Things is designed, and the overall design scheme is proposed. CC2530 chip is selected to be responsible for data processing and communication coordination. The main idea is to sense the environment through various terminal modules, that is, temperature sensors, smoke detection sensors, etc. Sensor nodes and coordination nodes independently establish a wireless local area network based on ZigBee protocol, and the sensor module in the sensor nodes distributed on the campus begins to power on and collect environment and security information continuously. The sensing node sends the detected information to the coordination node through multicast mode, and then the coordination node sends the detected information to the back-end control gateway through the serial port. STM32 displays security detection information through the TFT LCD module, which is processed by the system administrator; When the monitoring indicators exceed the normal range, the remote alarm function will be activated, and the back-end control gateway will send alarm information to the Android client.

articleTitle: Research on Maximum Power Point Tracking Technology of Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization Based on Greedy Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the increasing interest in renewable energy sources, photovoltaic power generation has emerged as a popular choice. The maximum power point tracking technology plays a crucial role in the efficient operation of photovoltaic systems. However, in scenarios involving partial shading, the solar array's power output demonstrates a complex multi-peak characteristic. When employing a standard method for monitoring peak power, one may inadvertently settle for a locally optimal value, rather than the global maximum. At the same time, the intelligent algorithm's adaptive particle swarm optimization algorithm has some tracking issues, such as large oscillation, low precision, and a long optimization time. This work proposes a control method for an adaptive particle swarm optimization algorithm based on a greedy algorithm to handle this challenge. The issues of standard adaptive particle swarm optimization methods are handled by incorporating the global optimal and local optimal particle difference, as well as the proportional coefficient of particle moving speed, and the solar energy consumption rate is enhanced further.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction and Analysis of Consumer Behavior Management Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the rapid development of deep learning technology and the arrival of the big data era, consumer behavior prediction has become a hot research topic in the field of e-commerce. This article conducts a comprehensive analysis and prediction of consumer purchasing behavior and feedback emotions based on a deep learning model. By constructing a convolutional neural network (CNN) and a long short-term memory network (LSTM), this study can effectively process and analyze image and text data on large-scale e-commerce platforms. Case studies show that the proposed model can accurately predict consumers' purchasing preferences and emotional tendencies, providing a scientific basis for personalized recommendations and product improvement. In addition, this article also explores the limitations of the research and proposes future research directions aimed at further improving the generalization ability and interpretability of the model to better serve e-commerce platforms and consumers.

articleTitle: A Dual-Sided LCCLC-Compensated IPT System for Enhanced Power Stability Across Wide Coupling Variations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper introduces an innovative high-order compensation topology for Inductive Power Transfer (IPT) systems-the Dual-Sided LCCLC Compensation Topology. Employing the LCCLC configuration on both the primary and secondary sides of the IPT system, it effectively addresses significant variations in the coupling coefficient caused by the displacement of coupling coils, thereby stabilizing the output power. The compensation topology not only exhibits excellent offset resistance but also simplifies the parameter matching process. Moreover, it can achieve Constant Voltage Output (CVO) and effective suppression of higher harmonics, demonstrating its robust robustness. To validate the performance of the proposed topology, a 3.3kW experimental platform was constructed. Simulation results indicate that, even with the coupling coefficient fluctuating within the range of 0.313 to 0.442, the system's output power remains stable within ±10% of 3.3kW. This confirms excellent performance of the proposed compensation topology in counteracting the displacement of coupling coils.

articleTitle: Laser and Grating Cross-Integrated Calibration Method for Wide Field-of-View 3D Cameras
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: A new calibration algorithm is proposed to improve the axial accuracy of wide field-of-view 3D cameras by addressing the problem of poor x-axial accuracy in traditional camera calibration methods for such cameras. The grayscale center of gravity method is utilized to extract the coordinates of the light stripe's center, and then the laser is vertically irradiated onto the calibration target to extract the corner points where the light intersects with black and white areas. The x-axial values corresponding to the extracted coordinates are normalized based on the known distances between adjacent corner point coordinates. Subsequently, a cross-fit is applied to the corner point coordinates, and the resulting pixel fit coefficients per column of the sensor are used for camera x-axis calibration. The test results show that the 3D camera calibrated by this calibration method with the farthest field of view width of 3800mm has a maximum average error of 2.99mm toward the measurement accuracy, which meets the practical use requirements of the camera.

articleTitle: Research on Masked Multiple Fault Method Based on 5-SDG
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Diagnosing multiple faults in complex industrial systems can be challenging. Multiple faults are categorized into induced faults, independent multiple faults, masking faults, and correlated multiple faults based on the causal relationships between fault sources. The diagnosis of masking faults can be particularly difficult due to their resemblance to single faults but with varying effects on neighboring nodes. The SDG fault diagnosis method is a prevalent approach used to diagnose multiple faults, which graphically depicts the complex interrelationships among system state variables. This paper proposes a 5-SDG-based masked multiple fault model, leveraging the correlations between different types of state variables in multiple fault scenarios to enhance the model's expressive power. Furthermore, a fault inference and judgment method is proposed based on this model in masked multiple fault scenarios. Experimental validation on a three-tank water tank model confirms the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of Railway Traction Power Supply System with PV Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: To promote energy-saving, emission-reduction, green, and low-carbon development in electrified railways, a scheme of photovoltaic (PV) integration into the traction power supply system is proposed. The PV power generation system is connected to the DC side of the AC-DC-AC converter of the co-phase compensation device, eliminating the need for AC-DC inverters. Through the cooperative control of the PV power generation system and the traction power supply system, it realizes the local consumption of new energy, real-time peak shaving and valley filling of traction load, and power quality compensation. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Mid-Term Load Forecasting for Electric Vehicle Charging Stations Based on LASSO-BPNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The rapid development of electric vehicles (EVs) posed a significant challenge to the stability of the power grid. Forecasting mid-term load for EV charging stations can assist grid management and operations. This paper proposes a new method based on LASSO-BPNN to forecast mid-term load. Firstly, a multi-feature indicators system was established, including environmental, economic, and societal factors. Secondly, this paper applied Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO) for feature selection to prevent overfitting. Thirdly, considering the indicators selected from LASSO, Back-Propagation Neural Network (BPNN) was used to predict the mid-term load for EV charging stations. Finally, this paper relied on the EV stations charging load data and multi-feature indicators data in Qingpu District, Shanghai, trained the overall model and acquired the forecast results. The results showed that the LASSO-BPNN model exhibited high forecast accuracy through error comparison analysis among different models.

articleTitle: Construction and Empirical Study of Regional Logistics Demand Prediction Model Based on BP-RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: To accurately and efficiently predict regional logistics requirements, a prediction model based on BP-RBF neural network is proposed. Considering the characteristics of nonlinear changes in logistics demand, in the modeling process, BP and RBF are first used to establish a single prediction submodel respectively, and then the weighted combination prediction model is further constructed, and finally the empirical analysis of logistics demand prediction in Shanghai is conducted. From the results it is clear that the combined logistics demand prediction model will have higher prediction accuracy for a single logistics demand prediction model, which greatly reduces the possibility of error, makes the prediction results more reasonable and accurate, and can provide help for the planning after regional logistics.

articleTitle: Smooth Control Strategy for Remote-Controlled Robot Under Unstable Time Delay Between Controller and Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In the remote-controlled robotics system, the reliable communication between the operator and the robot is important. However, unstable network connections are an inevitable problem. Because of the jitter time delay, the robot often doesn't receive the control instruction on time. The smooth motion strategy is proposed to overcome the impact of network delay on system performance. If the robot doesn't receive any new instructions in a presetting time period, the strategy calculates the predictive instructions to keep smooth control. Experiments results show the validity and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: SCR Device Design with Ultra-Low Capacitance and Low Trigger Voltage
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Data interfaces are widely used and the transmission rate is increasing, which puts higher requirements on the interface Electro Static Discharge (ESD) protection capability. A bi-directional SCR structure with Ultra-Low-Capacitance and Low Trigger Voltage DDSCR (ULCTDDSCR) is designed for this purpose. The structure is based on the DDSCR structure design, which reduces the capacitance of the device by increasing the spacing between the P-type injection wells and the N-type injection wells, and a high-concentration reverse diode is embedded at the edge of the injection wells to reduce the trigger voltage of the device.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Safety Analysis and Optimization of Wireless Electric Vehicle Charging Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Wireless power transfer (WPT) technology enhances the portability, safety, and flexibility of electric vehicle charging. However, the leakage of electromagnetic fields (EMF) from the coupling coils, which are in an open environment, may pose health risks. In this paper, we first establish a mathematical model of the electromagnetic field for coupling coils in wireless charging applications for electric vehicles. Based on this model, the influence of excitation current and coil turns on leakage EMF is analyzed. Subsequently, we optimize the turns of the coupling coil through simulation to ensure that the leakage EMF meets relevant safety standards while maintaining the power level of the system, ensuring that the leakage EMF in the human-accessible area during full-power operation does not affect human health. Finally, we validate the electromagnetic safety of the system through simulation and experimentation. This paper provides guidance for the electromagnetic safety design and optimization of wireless charging systems applied to electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Dot-Matrix Structured Light for Close Range Industrial Photogrammetry
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In close range industrial photogrammetry, a dot-matrix structured light technique is proposed to improve measurement efficiency and increase the density of three-dimensional point clouds. The dense bright spots in structured light pattern are used to replace manually pasted targets. Through image processing algorithms such as threshold segmentation, edge detection, and ellipse fitting, accurate extraction of the pixel coordinates of the bright spot centers has been achieved. This article also proposes a string bead matching algorithm that arranges the bright spot centers in all structured light images in the same order. The measurement experiments on large-sized plane have shown that using structured light technology can obtain accurate and dense three-dimensional point cloud of the plane, and also accurately measure its flatness error. The average distance from the point cloud to the fitting plane is 0.292mm, the distance variation interval is [−1.169mm, + 1.081mm], and the flatness error calculated based on the fitting plane is 2.253mm.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Self-Developed IKE Framework to Implement the National Security Standard IPSec Protocol
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper proposes a lightweight self-developed IKE framework to implement the national security standard IPSec protocol method, which is applied to embedded hardware to solve the problem that open-source frameworks such as strongSwan and OpenSwan do not meet the national security standard, do not support the national security algorithm, and they have huge code volume and complex structure. It is difficult for developers to implement the national security standard IPSec VPN under this framework. Finally, through the comparative test with the open source framework, the self-developed IKE framework is better than the existing open source framework.

articleTitle: Feature Mutual Learning Two-Stream Network for Facial StO2 Stress Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In our lives, we suffer from a variety of stresses, and different stress states respond to an individual's emotional state, making it crucial to accurately identify stress states. Most studies have used tissue oxygen saturation (StO2) to identify different stress states, but they rely too much on baseline data and discuss local and global regions separately, with the former requiring accurate a priori knowledge and the latter ignoring their intrinsic connection. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes a mutual learning two-stream network based on global and local regions, called MLNet, in which we use CNN for global information extraction and Vision Transformer (VIT) for local information extraction. In order to make the two types of information interact, we propose the mutual learning mechanism in the front-end and back-end of MLNet. The mutual learning mechanism enables the global and local information to learn from each other, thereby improving the feature extraction capability of the network. The experimental results show that the StO2 stress classification accuracy of MLNet reaches 79.52%, up to the current state-of-the-art (SOTA).

articleTitle: A Weight-Tunable Oxide Synaptic Transistor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Artificial neural systems demonstrate outstanding performance by processing sensory data and realtime contexts in parallel, far surpassing conventional von Neumann computers in terms of energy efficiency. This property has sparked widespread interest within the field of artificial intelligence. In recent years, research on electric-double-layer synaptic transistors has attracted much attention due to their similarity in ionic motion modulation to that of biological synapses, thereby demonstrating a wealth of potential application scenarios. In this paper, we demonstrate a solid-state electrolyte-gated transistor that uses TaO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> with a unique ionic composition as the insulating layer and transparent indium tin oxide (ITO) as the semiconductor layer to prepare artificial synaptic thin-film transistors (TFTs) with signal transmission and self-learning properties. The devices exhibit significant memory holding, memory bank voltage exceeds 6V at operating voltages below 10V. The shift of oxygen Void Sites in the insulating layer in synaptic transistor, entrained by electrical forces created from input signals, plays a crucial role in simulating synaptic behavior. In addition, the device successfully simulates the enhancement and inhibition of synaptic weights, such as excitatory postsynaptic current (EPSC), inhibitory response (IPSC), paired pulse facilitation (PPF), and long-term potentiation (LTP).

articleTitle: Construction of Indoor Physical Environment Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper puts forward a construction scheme of digital twin system for building indoor physical environment, and expounds the composition structure of a five dimensional digital twin system of building indoor physical environment. This paper integrates digital twin technology and BIM technology to collect data through a range of sensors and cameras. It facilitates real-time detection and dynamic display of building products, while monitoring performance changes of various equipment using an intelligent algorithm model. The primary objective is to establish a foundation for achieving green energy-saving in buildings and to offer guidance and support for building operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Equipment Intelligent Connection Cloud Platform Based on the Whole Lifecycle
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The development process of complex products requires a wide variety of equipment with a large quantity. Traditional equipment scheduling is difficult to meet rapidly changing production demands, and the efficiency and effectiveness of key bottleneck equipment are low. The existing inspection mode has a large granularity, and when equipment fails, the response time is long, the maintenance process and results are difficult to monitor, and the realtime operation status of the equipment cannot be obtained. Based on information technology such as micro-services, B/S architecture, Web-Service, this article constructs an equipment intelligent connection cloud platform based on the whole lifecycle to ensure the authenticity and reliability of “one account for one equipment”, establish an equipment sharing mechanism, improve the equipment sharing rate and utilization rate, and achieve capacity improvement. At the same time, an equipment map is established to achieve realtime detection of equipment data through equipment networking, and analyze equipment failure and health trend estimation of collected data to optimize equipment maintenance and pre-maintenance strategies, improve equipment support capabilities. The equipment intelligent cloud platform achieves significant improvements in equipment time utilization rate, performance utilization rate, and good product rate through equipment status visualization, information intelligence, and business digitalization, effectively improving the operational reliability and value of assets, reducing maintenance costs, thereby improving the overall operational quality of enterprises and reducing overall costs.

articleTitle: Electric Field Simulation and Structure Optimization of 12 kV Environmental-Friendly Gas Insulated Ring Network Cabinet
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The environmental-friendly gas-insulated ring network cabinet is referred to as an environment-friendly cabinet. The high-voltage circuit parts of the environment-friendly cabinet are mainly composed of conductors, VCB, and the knife-brake type three-station disconnector. The insulating support parts are composed of insulating board, insulating arms, and so on. The grounding parts consist of a metal shell and grounding contacts. Simulation of the electrostatic field of the environment-friendly cabinet is during the condition of isolation fracture. Simulation results show that there are local high electric fields on the metal surfaces of the support for VCB, moving contacts, and static contacts, which are 20.7SkV /mm, 10.06kV/mm, and 7.41kV/mm, respectively. Adding a thin metal sheet to the support for the VCB or filling the gap with silicone rubber will reduce the electric field to 4.S1kV/mm and 4.1kV/mm, respectively. The metal shielding structures are installed on both sides of the moving contact and the static contact of the disconnector, and the surface electric field intensity is reduced to 5.25kV/mm and 5.18kV/mm respectively on the disconnector during the state of isolation fracture. The optimized environment-friendly cabinet was tested for power-frequency voltage-withstand test and partial discharge. The results showed that the optimized environment-friendly cabinet passed the power-frequency voltage-withstand test and the magnitude of partial discharge was better than the initial scheme, which verified the feasibility of the optimization.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection Model-Based Analysis of Aircraft Flight Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The aim of this study is to carry out an analysis of flight data anomalies and propose a flight data anomaly detection model. First, we elaborate the establishment of the motion model and the anomaly identification method, and emphasize the potential application of the method in flight data anomaly detection. Through this method, we successfully recognized multiple flight data anomaly patterns. Subsequently, we conducted a statistical analysis for the anomalous data in order to fully understand the characteristics and distribution patterns of the anomalous data. Through statistical analysis, we not only confirmed the existence of anomalous data, but also revealed significant differences between anomalous data and normal flight data. These results provide us with important clues to deeply understand the anomalies of the flight data and provide useful support for flight safety and data analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Vegetable Replenishment and Pricing Strategies for Supermarkets Based on Time Series and Multi-Objective Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper conducts in-depth research on the replenishment and pricing strategy of vegetable products in fresh food superstores, and comprehensively analyzes the vegetable sales data by using Spearman correlation coefficient test, Support Vector Regression (SVR), Long and Short-term Memory Recurrent Neural Networks (LSTM), Multi-Objective Planning and Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm, etc. The data are integrated, cleaned, and visualized to reveal the changing law of vegetable category and specific product sales volume. Firstly, through data integration and cleaning and visualization, the changing law of vegetable category and single product sales volume is revealed, and the interrelationship between categories and single products is explored by using Spearman's correlation coefficient test; Secondly, combined with the cost-plus model and the time series prediction, the replenishment volume and pricing strategy of the next 7 days are provided with scientific basis; Finally, considering the actual operational constraints, the specific replenishment volume and pricing strategy are given through multi-objective planning and particle swarm optimization algorithm, a specific replenishment and pricing scheme is given. In addition, this paper also collects data from consumer preference, market competition, natural factors, and other aspects to provide comprehensive suggestions for the optimization strategy of the superstore and evaluates and improves the model.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Water Level of Lakes Based on PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The issue of water resource management in the Great Lakes has become a complex system due to the interaction of many factors. The water level regulation problem and the conflict of interest between stakeholders are outstanding and need to be solved urgently. First, we constructed a network flow model supported by flow balance differential equations. Based on the consideration of stakeholders' interests and constraints, we selected six representative stakeholders and transformed the problem of finding the optimal water level into a multi-objective planning problem. The upper and lower limits of the water level were determined by the historical extremes, and the intermediate value of the water level was determined by the KDE. Then, we calculated the optimal water level using the PSO algorithm. On this basis, a multi-objective planning model for dynamically predicting the optimal water level was established after comprehensively considering the basic model, environmental parameters, and dam control principles. We used ARIMA-LSTM hybrid model to realize the long-term prediction. The multi-objective planning model and trust-constr algorithm are used to realize the dynamic planning and finally the dynamic real-time control of the optimal water level.

articleTitle: Design of a High-Speed CAN FD Transmitter with Low Electromagnetic Interference
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to meet the high speed demands of the CAN FD bus protocol and ensure reliable communication in complex electronic system environments, this research paper presents a design for a high-speed CAN bus transmitter that minimizes Electromagnetic Interference (EMI). The design achieves this by implementing a delay control output power tube switch, which effectively reduces the signal voltage slew rate. Additionally, a bias circuit is incorporated to provide a stable gate voltage to the power tube, thereby enhancing signal stability and reducing EMI emitted by the transmitter. Based on the 0.18 μm 60 V BCD process to complete the design and simulation, the simulation results show that, under the 5V power supply voltage, The output signal of the CAN transmitter meets the requirements of the CAN protocol, that is, the dominant level of CANH is about 3.56V and the hidden level is about 2.52V. The dominant level of CANL is about 1.48V and the implicit level is about 2.52V. The symmetry of the output signal is good, and meet the requirements of CAN FD bus protocol high speed. The output common-mode signal has good voltage symmetry, and the fluctuation of common-mode interference is 361 mV.

articleTitle: Network Location and Distribution Planning of Packaging Waste Recycling Facilities Under Uncertain Demand
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to research the location and distribution planning of reverse logistics network for express packaging recycling and utilization under the environment of uncertain recycling demand. An effective solution is proposed. This paper builds a five-level recycling network including express outlets, recycling centers, remanufacturing centers, sales markets and landfill sites. Based on the fuzzy constraint of demand satisfaction, the constraint of flow balance between alternative recycling facilities and the constraint of capacity of alternative recycling facilities, an integer programming model is established to minimize the fixed cost of facility construction, the operation cost of facilities and the transportation cost of recycling facilities. Fuzzy chance constrained programming theory is used to deal with fuzzy parameter. Simulation experiments verify the effectiveness of the decision-making process of reverse logistics recovery network, which provides theoretical and practical support for sustainable development and circular economy.

articleTitle: Object Detection Based on Digital Twin-Based Road Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence and digital technology, digital twins are becoming more and more widely used in various fields, and have high application value in industrial production, architectural design and other fields. There are few datasets of extreme scenarios used in traditional object detection and vehicle autonomous driving training, resulting in unsatisfactory results of object detection and autonomous driving technology in complex environments. In this paper, a digital twin model of the road scene is built based on the rules of City Engine and the Unreal Engine 4 platform, which can be used to build a model of complex road scenes and shorten the model construction cycle. Based on the constructed digital twin model, the target detection task is carried out, and it is verified that the target detection and autonomous driving tests can be carried out in the digital twin model. It provides ideas for solving the problem of insufficient testing of autonomous driving and object detection tasks in complex and extreme scenarios.

articleTitle: A Secure Identity Authentication Method for Electric Vehicle TCU
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper analyzes the necessity of safe communication between the billing control unit in the Charging piles intelligent charging system as an important device of the Charging piles and the internet of vehicles platform, charging controller, mobile phone APP and electric vehicle charging card. This method focus on studying the secure data exchange between TCU and security gateway through SSL VPN at the link layer, ensuring the security of the link communication between TCU and security gateway. The security authentication method based on digital certificate is adopted between TCU and the internet of vehicles platform, and the national secret symmetric encryption algorithm is adopted for the transmission of uplink and downlink data, which effectively realizes the confidentiality and integrity of security business data transmission.

articleTitle: An Optimization Method of Federated Database Join Query Based on Computational Push-Down
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Nowadays, in order to solve the problem of information sharing in heterogeneous systems, federated database is a mature solution. However, the distributed database system also faces many performance bottlenecks. For example, a large amount of data is queried case, and the network transmission cost of data between nodes greatly affects the efficiency of the query. Therefore, how to improve the efficiency of distributed query becomes a problem that needs to be solved. This paper presents a query optimization method based on computational push-down for join query in federated database. The method select a proper query optimization policy based on global statistics, reducing the amount of data transmitted between nodes and greatly improving query efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on IWOA-GBDT Regression Prediction Model Based on Gradient Lifting Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This study developed and validated a regression prediction model based on improved whale optimization algorithm (IWOA) and gradient lifting decision tree (GBDT). This model shows high efficiency and accuracy in solving complex nonlinear relationship prediction problems, especially in data mining and machine learning applications. In this study, the GBDT model is debugged first, and then the IWOA algorithm is used to optimize the key parameters of GBDT by initializing the population through chaotic mapping sequence, adaptive inertia weighting and crossover mutation strategy, so as to find the optimal parameter combination to improve the prediction accuracy of the model, and the reliability of its prediction effect is verified by experimental results. The experimental results show that the IWOA-GBDT model is superior to the traditional GBDT model in many evaluation indexes, which shows that the IWOA algorithm effectively improves the prediction accuracy and reliability of the GBDT model. This study proves the effectiveness of IWOA-GBDT model in regression forecasting task. The model not only improves the prediction accuracy, but also shows good generalization ability. The successful application of this model provides a new perspective and method for future data mining and machine learning research.

articleTitle: A Novel Driving Ultrasonic Atomizer Based on Class-E Amplification Circuits
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel ultrasonic atomizer driving circuit based on Class-E power amplifiers. The introduced driving circuit adopts a Class-E radio frequency (RF) power amplifier with zero voltage switching, MOS transistor model AOD4130, driving chip model MIC4426, and 1.7 MHz resonant frequency atomizer. Besides, we also study the selection of RF choke in Class-E amplification circuits and the influence of the duty cycle of the driving signal on the atomization amount of the atomizer. Numerical simulations and hardware validations reveal that the inductance value of the RF choke is 100 μH and the ultrasonic atomizer with a duty cycle of 50% results in a promising atomization amount and high circuit efficiency.

articleTitle: Analysis of Mechanical Characteristics Test Data for SF6 Circuit Breakers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper analyzes the various data of the mechanical characteristic test of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> circuit breakers and point out the main factors that affect the accuracy of the test data. At the same time, we analyze the correlation between various test data, explore data analysis methods suitable for production sites, and illustrate through typical cases that the mechanical characteristic test data of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> circuit breakers should be comprehensively analyzed instead of single data comparison. Otherwise it is easy to make erroneous judgments and even cover up equipment hazards.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Image Processing Model Based on Computer Vision Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This research focuses on constructing an efficient image processing model, which is rooted in computer vision algorithms, to ameliorate image distortion and optimize visual display systems. The article initially discusses the significance of image distortion correction and its processing flow, encompassing detailed steps ranging from image preprocessing, model construction, parameter estimation, to pixel coordinate transformation. Furthermore, the design approach of computer vision display systems is explored, covering the theory of light field reconstruction, software and hardware design essentials, ensuring high fidelity in image presentation. Through multiple experiments conducted on datasets of distorted images, the effectiveness of the model in correcting distortion and enhancing image quality is empirically demonstrated, with the experimental results strongly supporting the feasibility and superiority of the model. This research holds positive implications for advancements and practical applications in the field of image processing.

articleTitle: Research on Corporate Financial Risk Prediction Model Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This study aims to explore the application effect of machine learning models in corporate financial risk prediction. By comprehensively applying various machine learning algorithms such as decision trees, random forests, and support vector machines (SVM), this paper constructs a set of financial risk prediction models and verifies and evaluates them on a dataset of actual listed companies. The study first preprocessed the data and selected features to optimize the model input quality. Then, through model training and cross-validation, the performance of different algorithms was compared, and the superior performance of the random forest model in this study was finally determined. The case analysis further demonstrates the potential of the model in practical financial risk management. Despite certain research limitations, such as the size and diversity limitations of the dataset, this study provides valuable insights into financial risk prediction and clear guidance for future research directions.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Variable Air Volume Valve Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper uses a method that combines fluid simulation and experiment to analyze the valve characteristic curve, and proposes a control method based on the inherent valve characteristic curve, which solves the shortcomings of traditional control methods such as traditional PID in valve control. This method obtains the pressure difference information between the two ends of the valve by obtaining the valve flow and opening from the sensor, solves the target valve opening through the pressure difference information and the set flow rate, and finally continuously adjusts the valve to the set flow range. This paper also conducts experiments and analysis on the flow averaging tube sensor in the variable air volume valve. In addition, this paper also designs the experimental platform, simulation platform and actual variable air volume valve.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Scheduling Strategy of DC Microgrid with Multiple Power Routers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The DC microgrid clusters have become one of the main networking forms for residential and industrial parks in the future due to its simple control method and high DC load and distributed energy consumption efficiency. This paper takes the low-voltage DC microgrid clusters as the research object. First, it gave the matching and scheduling method of the top-level control, and then designed a DC microgrid clusters experimental device to complete the communication and dispatch experiment. In the first stage, a packetized power dispatch protocol was proposed and the matching and power transmission dispatch are expressed as two problems respectively. In the matching problem, a mixed-integer nonlinear programming algorithm is better than a one-to-one matching algorithm in terms of matching efficiency, and it has obvious advantages in dealing with power line transmission loss. However, the greater time complexity ( <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$o$</tex>(2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">S</sup><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">×</sup><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D+D</sup>)) of the mixed-integer nonlinear programming algorithm than that (o(SD)) of the latter leads to longer matching time. In the scheduling problem, the heuristic algorithm performs better than the knapsack algorithm under the number of multi-power channels. In the second stage, a dispatch platform was designed for experimental verification. The four-cycle continuous scheduling experiment verified the correctness of the scheduling protocol.

articleTitle: Semantic Intelligent Understanding and Knowledge Generation of Target Features for SAR Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) has been widely used in all kinds of earth observation and reconnaissance. However, the characteristics such as speckle noise, perspective contraction, top and bottom inversion and so on make the information extraction of SAR images difficult. The existing effective knowledge acquisition method knowledge graph is difficult to solve the problem of the knowledge extraction for the electromagnetic scattering characteristic data based on images and signals. This paper proposes a method to intelligently understand the semantic information of target features and to generate characteristic knowledge from SAR images. Experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method for vehicle target regonition, analysis, and understanding.

articleTitle: Construction of Translation Corpus and Training of Translation Models Supported by Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The rapid development of globalization and the expansion of comprehensive cross-border communication have made machine translation play an increasingly prominent role in achieving communication and understanding between different languages. However, traditional translation models based on Statistical Machine Translation (SMT) have certain limitations when facing complex and diverse language phenomena. With the expansion of big data technology applications, this study utilized these massive amounts of text data to construct more accurate and flexible translation models. This study aimed to complete the task of constructing a translation corpus and training translation models. Firstly, bilingual data from different fields and themes were collected. Then, automatic alignment techniques were used to model language correspondence and remove low-quality alignment based on filtering techniques. The next step was to preprocess the collected raw data, which included processes such as word segmentation and tokenization. The purpose of these steps was to enable the processed data to be used to train the model. Finally, a sequence-to-sequence (Seq2Seq) translation model, such as an encoder decoder architecture and attention mechanism, was used to train the data. Through experimental evaluation, this study found that translation corpora and neural network translation models based on big data support have achieved better performance in translation quality. Compared to traditional translation models, the method adopted in this study can better capture complex language structures and semantic information, providing more accurate and fluent translation results.

articleTitle: Based on Vector Control and Design of Dual-motor Control System for Electric Wheelchair
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Based on the analysis of existing electric wheelchairs, this paper designs a simple electric wheelchairs with no mechanical steering mechanism and relying on differential control to realize turning and straight running. The structure, mathematical model and control method of permanent magnet synchronous motor used in electric wheelchair are analyzed. The double closed-loop vector control model of current and speed is established for a single permanent magnet synchronous motor used in electric wheelchair. The working principle of vector control is analyzed. On the basis of vector control of a single permanent magnet synchronous motor, considering the whole control strategy of the electric wheelchair, the cross-coupling control strategy is adopted in the speed loop, and a reasonable controller is designed to realize the coordinated control of the two motors. The simulation model of electric wheelchair drive motor is built, and the dual FOC algorithm is applied to realize the simultaneous control of two direct drive motors of electric wheelchair and reduce the delay of control loop.

articleTitle: HIL Simulation Experimental Teaching System Design of PEM Hydrogen Production Load
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: To address the absence of hydrogen production equipment in the experimental teaching platform dedicated to new energy power generation, and in order to improve the teaching effect and enhance the electrical engineering students' understanding of hydrogen production load system, this study focuses on investigating the rectifier load of a proton exchange membrane (PEM) AC hydrogen production system. Firstly, PEM electrolyzer electrical model is established. Secondly, power conversion system models is established to analyzed harmonic characteristics. Finally, hardware-in-loop (HIL) computer simulation experiment teaching system is designed based on PEM electrolyzer and power conversion system models.

articleTitle: Research on AIGC Classification Content Generation System of Tourism Resources in Jilin Province Based on Computer Machine Vision Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, a tourism information forecasting system in computer aided environment is established. In this way, the sparsity of various data can be effectively integrated. In particular, forecasts for foreign visitors have been optimized. This paper aims to combine machine vision and deep learning to build a new efficient multi-source information perception method. According to the basic theory of imaging, the acquisition of tourist pose information is planned, so as to obtain the corresponding relationship between human visual image and human pose. In this way, multi-source image data obtained from multiple cameras is integrated. The test results show that compared with other tourism information forecasting systems, this system has a better forecasting effect. The establishment of the computer-aided tourism information prediction system can not only effectively integrate the sparsity of various data, especially the prediction of foreign tourists has been optimized, but also through the combination of machine vision and deep learning, a new method of efficient multi-source information perception has been constructed. In addition, the system integrates multi-source image data obtained by the camera, and has a good prediction effect. Therefore, the prospect of computer-aided tourism information forecasting system is very broad and is expected to play an important role in the tourism industry.

articleTitle: Research on Communication Transmission of Ultra-Low Field MRI Digital Receiver Based on PXIe Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This article focuses on responding to today's ever- increasing demands for convenient and economical medical solutions, with special attention to the innovation of MRI systems with ultra-low magnetic field strengths of 0.1 Tesla and below. With its obvious advantages of being lightweight, compact and cost-effective, this type of MRI system is becoming an ideal way to expand the coverage of medical services to primary medical institutions and even remote areas. The article details a high-performance digital receiver specially designed to meet the technical challenges of ultra-low-field MRI. The receiver integrates the cutting-edge PXIe technology architecture and is based on National Instruments (NI). Hardware modules are core components. The research work not only includes systematic theoretical conception and specific implementation, but also includes a comprehensive practical verification process under laboratory conditions. Especially in a 50-milliTesla-level ultra-low-field MRI experimental setup, the researchers conducted in-depth system integration and functional performance testing of the digital receiver, and fine- tuned the receiving coil (RX Coil). Experimental evidence shows that this digital receiver developed based on the PXIe architecture exhibits excellent signal capture and processing performance in ultra-low field MRI environments. Thanks to this, combined with Nl's data acquisition (DAQ) hardware equipment and LabVIEW visual programming with this tool, the R&D team can efficiently complete the system construction and quickly put it into practical application within a short R&D period, thus effectively promoting the in-depth development and widespread application of ultra-low field MRI technology at the practical level.

articleTitle: An Active/Reactive Power Control Strategy for Photovoltaic Power Station Under Grid Fault
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Grid-connected photovoltaic (PV) systems are usually supposed to provide voltage support during grid faults to help the recovery of power system from voltage sags. This paper investigates the optimized distribution of active and reactive power of grid-connected PV system in case of balanced grid fault, with the purpose to provide maximum grid voltage support during fault conditions. Taking the grid impedance into consideration, the principles of voltage support during grid fault are analyzed in detail, which revealed that the maximum voltage support can be achieved by injecting active and reactive current proportional to the R/X ratio of the equivalent grid impedance. Meanwhile, it can be observed how the penetration level of PV systems exerts influences on the voltage support effect. Several scenarios of simulation are conducted to verify the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Real-Time Athlete Tracking Method Based on Computer Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the continuous development of computer deep learning technology, the research of athlete target detection and tracking has attracted more and more attention. The challenge of athlete tracking lies in the changes of sports environment and athletes' clothing. In recent years, with the development of deep learning technology, especially the continuous improvement of target detection and tracking algorithms, the performance of athlete target detection and tracking has been greatly improved. yolov5 object detection algorithm and DeepSORT multi-object tracking algorithm based on object detection have achieved excellent results in the field of pedestrian tracking, but the related research in the field of sports object tracking is relatively limited. This paper adopts yolov5. As the detection part of the athlete tracking algorithm, the attention mechanism is improved, and then the DeepSORT algorithm is improved to realize the real-time tracking of athletes. In this paper, ShuffleNet is used as the apparent feature extraction network to solve the mismatching problem of DeepSORT algorithm in the tracking process, and ECA attention mechanism is added to optimize the feature extraction capability of the network. In the aspect of trajectory matching, DIOU (Distance-IOU) is used to improve the matching process by considering the degree of overlap of target frames and the Distance between target frames. Experimental tests on self-made data sets show that Multiple Object Tracking Accuracy (MOTA) is increased by 3.7% and Multiple ObjectTracking Precision (MOTP) is increased by 2.6%. The results show that the improved method can effectively improve the track disappearance and target ID switching of athletes in the process of target tracking.

articleTitle: Research on PID Control of BP Neural Networks Based on PSO Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In many industrial production fields, the proportional integral derivative (PID) control algorithm is widely applied by the rapid evolution of its control theory. However, conventional PID controllers faced certain difficulties in parameter tuning, real-time online adjustment, and processing of complex nonlinear systems. To solve this problem, the researchers organically combine the PID control algorithm and other mature control strategies to form a new control theory. In this paper, we propose a neural network PID control method based on particle swarm optimization (PSO). This method combines the adaptive learning ability of the BP neural network with the PID controller, and corrects PID control parameters in real time to improve the system stability. In order to overcome the problem that the bp-pid adaptive process is apt to be a problem of the local optimum and the convergence speed slow, optimization is carried out using an improved PSO algorithm. Experimental results show that this method can reduce system overshoot effectively and reduce steady-state error and drastically reduce the steady-state time compared to traditional PID control and bp-pid control. Therefore, the method studied in this paper can greatly improve system control accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Internet Abnormal Traffic Detection Based on WOA-BiLSTM-Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the rise of the Internet, network application coverage is becoming more and more extensive, and a large amount of data has brought security issues to the network environment. In order to detect abnormal network traffic, this research builds a model based on the WOA using BiLSTM-Attention, and conducts empirical research using certain network traffic data as an example. The research results show that the root mean square error (RMSE) of WOA-BiLSTM-Attention is 79.1746, which is better than the traditional prediction model and is more suitable for predicting Internet traffic. Its prediction results can provide certain reference significance for abnormal traffic detection and abnormal data detection in other fields in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Semantic Retrieval System for Large-Scale Biomedical Texts
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper presents a semi-interpretable model of biomedical knowledge based on a hierarchical topic model to address the challenges posed by the large number of biomedical texts with varying types, complex structures, and fuzzy features. The research implements a large-scale biomedical text intelligent semantic retrieval system to support long queries. The system can retrieve relevant biomedical literature based on a long query that combines the patient's biomedical record and various examination indexes provided by the attending physician or graduate student. The accuracy and completeness of the search are considered.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control System of High Voltage Transmission Converter Valve Based on Computer Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This article deeply studies the application of intelligent control system for high-voltage transmission converter valve based on computer technology in hybrid multi-terminal DC transmission system and its coordinated control strategy for DC voltage. With the help of advanced computer technology, the system achieves precise control and intelligent management of converter valve, significantly improving the stability and controllability of power system. In steady state conditions, this study specifically considers the impact of equivalent resistance of DC line on the control of DC voltage station, and designs targeted control strategy to effectively avoid long-term overvoltage operation problem of DC side voltage in multi-terminal DC transmission system. In transient conditions, this paper proposes a DC voltage coordination control scheme dominated by master-slave control, supplemented by voltage deviation control as a backup strategy. At the same time, the study also designs a smooth switching control strategy for slave station to take over DC voltage control authority and a logic simplified voltage deviation control strategy to further enhance the robustness and stability of the system. Finally, an electromagnetic transient model of hybrid multi-terminal DC transmission is built through computer software Matlab/Simulink environment, and the proposed control strategy is verified by simulation. The results prove its correctness and effectiveness. This study provides strong theoretical support and practical guidance for intelligent control and optimization of high-voltage DC transmission system.

articleTitle: Optimized Design of Heliostat Layout Based on Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Its core components are the heliostat mirror field and collector. In this paper, an optimization model based on particle swarm algorithm is proposed for the design of heliostat mirror field, aiming to maximize the annual average output thermal power per unit mirror area under the condition of satisfying the rated power. This paper first establishes an accurate method for calculating the solar altitude angle, solar azimuth angle and normal direct radiant irradiance, and uses these data to calculate the optical efficiency and output thermal power of the heliostat mirror field. Then, this paper adopts the particle swarm algorithm, which considers the heliostat as a particle and searches for the optimal solution by adjusting the parameters such as the position, size, and mounting height of the particle. In this paper, the masking loss, truncation efficiency, cosine efficiency and other factors between the fixed-sun mirrors are also taken into account, and the sensitivity analysis is carried out. Finally, the effectiveness of the method in this paper is verified by experiments and compared with existing methods.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Video Surveillance Identification System in Smart Campus
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper develops a video surveillance identification system for campus security needs. In this system, a video analysis and processing platform based on Spark is designed. Based on the new scheme technology and OpenCV library to process massive video data and face recognition, the main tasks of this system include video collection, video file preprocessing, face detection, face model training, face recognition and communication with the client. According to the detailed analysis and design of each module above, this paper combines each module organically to form the architecture of Spark based distributed video processing system. The new processing scheme can greatly improve the processing and analysis efficiency of massive data, and has many advantages: more flexible architecture and strong scalability. It brings convenience to the later expansion and iterative upgrade of the system, and also provides convenience for the later expansion and management.

articleTitle: Minimizing Cold Start Time on Serverless Platforms Based on Time Series Prediction Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The research in this paper focuses on minimizing cold start times in serverless platforms using time series forecasting methods. The study begins by analyzing the mechanism of cold start issues in serverless computing and proposes a method based on time series prediction to forecast future function call volumes. This method is designed to reduce cold start occurrences by pre-starting functions based on predicted demand. Experimental validation confirms the effectiveness of this approach. The methodology includes collecting historical request data, preprocessing, parameter determination, and model training. The SARIMA model is employed for predictions, allowing for dynamic resource allocation in response to predicted demand, significantly reducing cold start times and resource wastage compared to traditional static threshold-based methods. The study demonstrates that using SARIMA models for future function call predictions effectively minimizes cold start times on cloud-native platforms, enhancing system responsiveness and resource utilization.
