articleTitle: Text Data Anti Pinch Technology Based on Visual Font Filtering Binary Security Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Text entrainment attacks target users by embedding malicious information in text data. Due to malicious information being hidden in normal text data and difficult to detect, this attack method has a high successful rate. This paper proposes a new anti pinch technique for binary text compression attacks. Firstly, one-dimensional ordinary text data is transformed into two-dimensional data based on the dot matrix or vector graphs. Second, the text character's library based on FreeType is designed, which utilizes the characteristics of FreeType's character library to filter glyph and vector data during font file parsing. Finally, specific binary format characters or vector characters are checked in these data to quickly and efficiently discover potential embedded binary data, effectively preventing malicious attacks by binary code during transmission, storage, and use, ensuring the security and integrity of text data.

articleTitle: Road Crack Segmentation Based on Dual Branch Attention Mechanism and Multi-Scale Features
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In road surface crack segmentation algorithms, obtaining comprehensive contextual information is crucial. While many solutions use the Transformer architecture for global information, its computational complexity requires combining it with CNN for feature extraction, making multi-scale contextual information extraction challenging. Although UNet-based networks are popular for fine-grained features, their decoder introduces redundant contents. To address above-mentioned issues, The paper proposes DBAUNet, incorporating SVD-ASPP (Same Value Dense ASPP) for global information extraction and DBAM (Dual Branch Attention Mechanism) to enhance crack information while suppressing background information. SVD-ASPP prevents crack disconnections, ensuring more accurate segmentation results.

articleTitle: Application of Data Mining Algorithm in Network Music Teaching Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the development of Internet technology, online music teaching platform has gradually become an important way to learn music. Under this social background, it becomes very important to study how to optimize and improve the effect of online music teaching platform by using data mining algorithm. Moreover, the data mining algorithm can further strengthen the analysis and mining of a large number of learning data on the platform, and provide a scientific basis for individualized education. Data mining algorithms can also analyze students' learning habits, interests and other information, so as to achieve personalized teaching. Moreover, the platform can accurately recommend music teaching content suitable for each student's corresponding level of interest. According to the experimental data, the number of users of the online music teaching platform based on data mining algorithm is more than 76.23%, and the highest value even reaches 94.62%. Not only that, the teaching platform has also greatly improved the learning of students, and the proportion of students who use the system is as high as 84.05%. It can be seen that this research can improve the effect of online music teaching through data mining algorithm, and finally promote the completion of personalized learning.

articleTitle: Research on Historical Data Model of Wind Farm Based on Computer Missing Data Processing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to ensure the safe and reliable transmission of wind turbines in the power grid, this topic studies the Kafka wireless communication technology. It can effectively restrain all kinds of unstable factors brought about by power grid operation. This paper realizes the effective protection of power grid signal. Then, the paper uses Thompson quartile method and multi-point interpolation technique to process the abnormal data. First, the abnormal energy value that is cut out or close to 0. It is removed at two different positions of cut out, and it is partitioned. The outliers are partitioned and finely cleaned by Thompson quartile method to reduce the modeling complexity in the process of recognition. The four-point interpolation technique is used to reconstruct the anomaly observation data, and the complete data of wind speed and power are obtained. The practical application and experiment show that the proposed scheme can not only effectively overcome the current network instability, high concurrency and other problems, but also has the advantages of large capacity, high transmission efficiency and scalability. The research results of this project will lay the foundation for the secure and stable transmission of data in the field of wind power, and will also provide a new research method for the relevant information processing in the power sector.

articleTitle: Integrated Forecasting and Protection Strategy for Countering Illegal Elephant Poaching: A Grey Model and ARIMA Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive approach to forecasting and mitigating illegal elephant poaching. Initially, a GM(1,1) grey prediction model is established to forecast the incidence of elephant poaching over the next five years, highlighting the urgency and necessity of addressing this issue. Subsequently, a detailed protection strategy is formulated to safeguard elephants from illegal hunting, accompanied by the visualization of the proposed measures using word cloud representations. Finally, assuming the successful implementation of the project over the next five years, an ARIMA time series prediction model is constructed to forecast the illegal killing of wild elephants, providing a comparative analysis with unprotected forecasts to underscore the imperative nature of the project.

articleTitle: Research on the Design and Application of a New Lightweight and Efficient Electric Wire Stripper for Power Construction and Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: As the continuous development of power industry, the construction and maintenance of steel core aluminum strand stripping equipment becomes more and more important. Stripping of steel core aluminum strand wire is a common and tedious link in these works, people often have to strip wire manually, time-consuming and labor-intensive, how to improve the efficiency and quality of stripping wire has become an urgent problem to be solved. Based on this, a new kind of lightweight and efficient electric steel core aluminum strand stripper is designed in this paper, which uses chain fixture to fix and strip steel core aluminum strand, and its application in electric power construction and maintenance is studied.

articleTitle: Research on Passive Localization in Circular Formation Flight of UAVs with Simulated Annealing Optimization Based on Triangulation and Greedy Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In addressing the challenges of passive localization and adjustment strategies during circular formation flight of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), this paper proposes a pure azimuthal passive localization model based on triangulation and greedy strategy. The model initially converts precise angle signals into accurate azimuthal information, conducts deviation analysis on the positions, and then employs a greedy strategy for fine-tuning. The simulated annealing approach is utilized to continually evaluate the position using azimuthal information obtained through angle signal conversion, optimizing the position during the fine-tuning process. Ultimately, the paper achieves uniform positioning of UAVs along the circumference, realizing precise localization of unmanned aerial vehicles. The study uses a scenario involving 10 UAVs as an example, discussing all possible situations based on the proposed model. Finally, simulation experiments conducted in Matlab validate the feasibility and robustness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Visual Encoding Method for MR Interface Operation Process Prompts Supporting Blind Area Assembly
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Recently, research on the accuracy of visual cues in human-machine interface prompts within industrial settings remains insufficient, particularly when dealing with manual assembly tasks that face multiple physical obstructions and limited visibility. Centering on the two dimensions of visual element layout and visual spatial depth, the blind zone visual information coding model is constructed to reveal the real-time occlusion relationship between manual operational gestures and the objectives of tasks within blind zones. Leveraging the principle of “3D image geometric transformation”, this model adeptly translates intricate three-dimensional information onto a more manageable two-dimensional plane to reveal the real-time occlusion relationship between manual operational gestures and the objectives of tasks within blind zones. Through a case study experiment, the proposed visual encoding method was shown to effectively reduce the dispersion of operators' attention during assembly tasks in blind zones, compared to traditional assembly setups and visual encoding groups with digital mirror scenes. It can improve efficiency and accuracy in operators' assembly tasks in blind zones and reduce the cognitive load in understanding the intent of these tasks. Furthermore, in the aspect of enhancing user performance, the alignment of dynamic guiding cues with the intuitiveness of cognitive operations and the effectiveness of the cognitive framework of the MR interface presented within the operator's field of view are identified as two pivotal controllable factors for elevating user performance. The findings hold significant implications for guiding research in this direction.

articleTitle: Research on Bode Data Processing Method Based on Python
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Bode plot is often used to analyze the vibration of rotating machinery, which can graphically display the relationship between amplitude, phase and rotational speed during the start-up and shutdown of the equipment. The key to drawing a Bode plot is to obtain vibration amplitude and phase data corresponding to the rotational speed. Based on the Python language, this article utilizes digital signal processing functions provided by the SciPy package to process the key phase signal and vibration signal of the equipment, obtaining accurate absolute phase and amplitude. The signal processing procedure and key Python code are given in the article. The data processing method is verified by processing the vibration signal during the start-up of a steam turbine in a certain power plant.

articleTitle: A Neural Network Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Conflict Resolution Method Based on Bat Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In the context of airspace integration, to ensure the safety of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), a method for resolving UAV conflicts based on the optimization of bat algorithm and neural network is proposed. This method combines the advantages of both techniques. The neural network output controls the UAV's current step-length release strategy, while encoding the parameters of the neural network as bat coordinates for global optimization. Finally, the optimized release strategy is outputted to form a release trajectory. Through simulation experiments, it is verified that this release model can provide high-quality release trajectories for both conflicting UAVs. The model is simple and efficient, ensuring rapid release of UAVs when encountering conflict threats.

articleTitle: Research on Athlete Scientific Training Management System Based on New Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper firstly constructs a scientific and efficient auxiliary method for selecting and training athletes Athlete training expert system. The system collects information such as competition experience and training program obtained by coaches in the actual operation process. And through the integration of these tacit knowledge by computer, this paper is to build the corresponding knowledge base. Through Prolog programming, the functions of knowledge base and inference engine are combined. This paper establishes a professional sports training system with a hybrid program. The color and depth information provided by Kinect can be used to track different types of players in real time. Using standard serial interface, the 3D motion information of the player is imported into the computer, and the 3D spatial coordinates and motion rate are analyzed by dynamic time planning method. In this way, the sports characteristics of each type of players are obtained and the corresponding training programs are formulated accordingly. The effect of this method on improving the exercise ability is verified by the simulation test.

articleTitle: Adaptive Secure Homomorphic Encryption Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Due to the threat of future quantum computers, it is necessary to develop cryptographic schemes that are resistant to quantum attacks. Lattice based cryptographic schemes have resistance to quantum attacks and security under worst-case assumptions that are difficult to solve. To solve the problems of large size of public and private keys, low encryption efficiency, and large noise growth in identity based encryption schemes, an adaptive secure identity based all homomorphic encryption scheme based on Learning with Errors (LWE) is constructed. This scheme uses {0,1} matrices to store plaintext, significantly improving encryption efficiency compared to single bit encryption schemes. It uses key conversion technology to achieve homomorphic operations and modulus conversion technology to reduce noise. It also converts IDs into bit sequences to construct an encryption scheme for adaptive security. Compared to selective security that only provides security guarantees for specific types of attacks, adaptive security is suitable for general scenarios, providing higher security guarantees and being able to cope with more challenging attack situations. It has been proven through the LWE problem that the security of our proposed scheme satisfies IND-ID-CPA. Finally, the experimental results indicate that this scheme introduces less noise, and has higher encryption efficiency and performance.

articleTitle: Time Series Forecasting Study Based on Decomposition-Prediction-Optimization Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Time series are ubiquitous in everyday life, and their predictive techniques are particularly crucial. However, the accuracy of a single model's prediction is often unsatisfactory, and due to the characteristics of different models, there are many limitations. To enhance prediction accuracy, this study proposes a third-order model of hybrid decomposition prediction optimization. It involves decomposing data using the Singular Spectrum Analysis signal decomposition algorithm, followed by prediction using Long Short-Term Memory neural networks, and subsequently, applying the Grey Wolf algorithm to optimize the weighted prediction results. Through comparative experiments, this hybrid approach in the study outperforms other hybrid models in various evaluation metrics, demonstrating higher precision.

articleTitle: Ultra-low Capacitance Bidirectional SCR Device Design
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Data interfaces are widely used and transmission rates are increasing, which puts higher demands on the interface Electro Static Discharge (ESD) protection. In this paper, a TVS device with Ultra-Low-Capacitance DDSCR (ULCDDSCR) structure is proposed. The structure is based on a Dual Direction SCR (DDSCR) structure design, which reduces the barrier capacitance formed by the injected trap while preventing leakage from occurring in the device by increasing the injection of the N-type trap region once. Suitable process and structural parameters are obtained through simulation analysis.

articleTitle: An Improved YOLOv8-Based Target Detection Algorithm for Online Rumor “Shoe Print Flow and Blood Flow”
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Automatic detection and identification of network rumors are of great significance for maintaining network security and public order, but existing detection methods still have many challenges in identification accuracy, real-time and multimodal data processing capability. In order to effectively improve the detection efficiency and accuracy of the target of network rumor “shoe print flow + blood flow”, this paper proposes a target detection method based on YOLOv8_WRD algorithm. First, we design a multi-scale null DilateWRD architecture to adapt to the differences in the performance of police-related content in different media formats; second, we enhance the model's ability to capture details and its recognition robustness under variable backgrounds by introducing an improved adaptive attention module, the SPD-Conv module; and lastly, we add the WRDFormer two-layer routing attention mechanism and replace the backbone network with the RapidNet to replace the backbone network, which further improves the interaction and fusion efficiency of cross-modal features and optimizes the model's performance in recognizing rumors in complex network environments.

articleTitle: High-Resolution Pearl Identification Based on Orthogonal-Polarization-Gating Optical Coherence Tomography System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) is extensively employed in clinical diagnostics and research. However, traditional OCT methods offer limited insight, primarily providing intensity data. Polarization-Sensitive Optical Coherence Tomography (PS-OCT), a functional extension of OCT, not only captures tissue structure but also detects changes in light polarization within tissues, enhancing contrast in images. Challenges persist in PS-OCT, including inaccuracies in measuring tissue birefringence due to varying light phase and the oversight of circular birefringence properties, affecting tissue characterization. Mueller matrix offers a comprehensive solution but demands extensive data acquisition time, hampering imaging speed. Despite high resolution, OCT suffers from shallow imaging depth and bulky, costly devices. Therefore, non-destructive subcutaneous imaging holds promise in tissue detection. This study optimizes PS-OCT through Orthogonal-Polarization-Gating Optical Coherence Tomography (OPG-OCT), offering cost-effectiveness, automation, rapid sampling, and high-resolution imaging. OPG-OCT addresses imaging quality issues and achieves rapid target detection, acquiring two-dimensional images in 0.0125 seconds. Integration of deep learning algorithms enhances tissue microstructure observation, yielding longitudinal resolution of 8.9 micrometers and lateral resolution of 18.8 micrometers. This system enables high-quality image reconstruction for precise biological feature identification, advancing applications such as pearl identification in biological research.

articleTitle: DC Series Arc Fault Detection Method for Photovoltaic Array Based on Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the continuous development of the domestic photovoltaic industry and the increasing installed capacity of photovoltaics, fires occur frequently in photovoltaic power stations. The cause of fires is often caused by DC arc faults. Therefore, a reliable DC arc fault detection method for photovoltaic arrays is of great significance for ensuring the safe and reliable operation of photovoltaic power generation systems. The photovoltaic array is greatly affected by environmental factors, the output data is unstable, and the amplitude change of the fault arc data is also uncertain, which leads to the misjudgment of the DC arc detection method. Aiming at the DC series arc fault of photovoltaic array, this paper proposes a detection method of DC series arc fault of photovoltaic array based on random forest. Based on the Simlink platform, a simulation model of photovoltaic series arc fault is built. The simulation model is used to obtain the series arc fault data, and the difference between the normal string and the series arc fault string is compared. The DC series arc fault data is analyzed by statistical method and the feature quantity is extracted as the training set. The feature quantity is used to train the random forest model to establish the photovoltaic series fault diagnosis model. The string voltage data of each group collected by the inverter before and after the series arc fault of a photovoltaic project in a new energy enterprise in Xiamen are used for diagnosis. The inverter string data of the actual series arc fault verify that the method can effectively identify the DC series arc fault, and is less affected by environmental factors. The stability of the detection method is good.

articleTitle: Digital Twin-Driven Bearing Defect Model and Life Cycle Prediction Research
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: It is recommended to use digital dual drives to predict the complete life of bearing. This method consists of a numerical model with two defects and a complete life cycle prediction of two parts of the bearing. The digital twin defect modeling employs the Kalman Filter Algorithm (KFA) to fit the defect area of the physical objects, enhancing the accuracy of mapping the physical objects into the virtual space. Improved Short - and Long Term Memory Networks (LSTM) are used to predict the entire life cycle of bearings. It predicts the life cycle of physical objects based on data obtained from dual fault zones. The effectiveness of this method was confirmed using an open bearing dataset. The analysis results demonstrate its capability to effectively fit defect area sizes and predict the bearing life cycle.

articleTitle: Committee-Based Threshold Classification Algorithm with Reinforcement Active Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The deep learning-based computing paradigm plays a pivotal role in contemporary society. Nevertheless, current methods are plagued by the challenges of demanding extensive labeled data and excessive training resource consumption. Active learning (AL) diminishes the quantity of required training and labeling data by selecting representative samples. Nonetheless, traditional AL approaches demand a significant number of iterations and sample labels, making them susceptible to data bias and excessive human intervention. In response to these challenges, this paper presents a threshold classification algorithm based on query by committee (TC-QBC) that integrates reinforcement learning techniques. Unlike conventional sampling methods, TC-QBC assigned dynamic weights to labels during committee voting. Subsequently, a resampling operation was executed by establishing a threshold to attain the data classification objective. Following validation in pertinent experiments, TC-QBC exhibits outstanding classification prowess. Our work has shown that the proposed method can improve model performance while reducing the resources necessary for training.

articleTitle: Attacker Hunting in the Intranet Using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: For attacker's intranet lateral movement stage of the cyber kill chain, current cyber defense strategies face the problems of lacking dynamism, being unable to make realtime decisions, and failure to take into account the dynamic changes of attacker's strategies. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a new gridworld model to describe the lateral movement scenario. The multi-agent stochastic game is used to model attack and defense process, and the Nash Q-learning algorithm is used to solve the optimal cyber defense strategy. Through multiple simulation experiments, it turns out that the proposed model has good convergence, and the average defense success rate of the defender is more than 70%, which verifies the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Optimal Site Selection and Capacity Determination of Distributed Photovoltaic Sources Connected to Distribution Network Based on Squirrel Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The research on site selection and capacity determination of distributed photovoltaic sources is a key link in the planning of distribution networks containing distributed photovoltaic sources. With the goal of minimizing the overall cost of distributed power generation and distribution network losses, and taking into account constraints such as node flow equation, node voltage, branch flow, and distributed power generation capacity, the model of optimal site selection and capacity determination of distributed photovoltaic sources connected to distribution network is constructed. The squirrel search algorithm is used to solve the model. The effectiveness of the constructed model and algorithm is verified through simulation examples.

articleTitle: A Deep Ground Roll Noise Suppression Method Based on DRinCGAN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The deep seismic reflection data obtained from actual field exploration contains rich geological information, but also suffers from severe interference, especially low-frequency strong ground roll. This kind of noise is widely distributed and intertwined with reflected waves, seriously damaging the characteristics of effective reflection signals and leading to a decrease in signal-to-noise ratio, which affects the quality of the data. In order to improve the signal-to-noise ratio and support subsequent seismic exploration research, it is necessary to suppress ground roll. In recent years, deep learning technology has provided a new approach for ground roll suppression. However, creating high-quality target seismic data training sets is time-consuming and traditional methods have limitations. To solve these problems, a ground roll suppression method based on DRinCGAN is proposed, which combines disentangled networks and recurrent generative networks, designs feature encoders to extract effective reflection waves and noise features, and designs a ground roll suppression generator to obtain processed seismic records. Compared with supervised learning methods, this method does not require paired data and is more suitable for real seismic records. Theoretical analysis, numerical simulation, and practical processing results show that the method is effective and feasible, enriches the theory of pre-stack ground roll suppression, and expands the technical means for processing complex seismic data.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Superconducting Fault Current Limiter on the Reactive Active Support Capability of DFIG-Based Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In the last few years, wind power generation and energy storage have made significant progress in terms of technical level and unit capacity. The main application of wind turbines is the DFIG. Because its stator is directly connected to the mains, the terminal voltage of the DFIG drops sharply when the mains voltage drops sharply due to faults or other reasons. It will disconnect the generator from the power grid, and then affect the strength of the power grid, resulting in stability problems. The superconducting fault current limiter is used in some new measures to improve the LVRT capability of wind farms. This allows the terminal voltage of the double-fed wind turbine to be improved in the event of voltage dips. In this paper, its influence on the active reactive power support capability of a DFIG is analyzed. The results show that the use of a superconducting fault current limiter has a good effect on improving the reactive active support capability of double-fed wind turbines.

articleTitle: Lane Line Segmentation Based on Comparative Analysis of Three Convolutional Neural Networks SegNet, U-Net and Attention-U-Net
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In the context of the rapid development of intelligent vehicles and artificial intelligence technology, this paper independently constructs 50 small sample datasets containing different scenes and different light intensities. The dataset is divided into 8:2 training and validation sets, and three different networks, SegNet, U-Net, and Attention-U-Net, are utilized to train the above images for 300 epochs and validate them respectively, which result in the following: the mIOU value of SegNet is 89.65%, the mPrecision value is 96.84%, mRecall value is 91.98%; mIOU value of U-Net is 90.05%, mPrecision value is 95.39%, mRecall value is 93.68%; mIOU value of Attention-U-Net is 90.26%, mPrecision value is 95.98%, mRecall value is 93.39%. After comprehensive analysis, it is concluded that, under the same conditions, the Attention-U-Net network for lane line segmentation has the comprehensive performance of faster convergence speed, more accurate segmentation results, better segmentation effect on the lane lines with intricate light intensity, and strong robustness, which is very suitable for the segmentation of lane lines in intelligent vehicles and is of great significance for the development of the perception field of intelligent vehicles.

articleTitle: Study on the Coupling Mechanism of Machining Process Parameters and Part Machining Accuracy Prediction in Intelligent Production Line
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper studies part machining accuracy prediction. Firstly, the coupling mechanism of intelligent production line machining process parameters is studied, and a parameter coupling model based on correlation analysis is proposed, which can consider the interaction and influence between different parameters and optimize the machining process to a certain extent. Then, a machine learning-based part machining accuracy prediction method is proposed for the actual situation of intelligent production line machining. The method combines error network diagrams for multi-process machining units and enables the prediction of part machining accuracy by combining the production results of the previous process with the process parameters of the current process. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed parameter coupling model and accuracy prediction method are verified through experiments. The experimental results show that the proposed method can significantly improve the accuracy and stability of part machining, and also provide a certain theoretical and practical basis for the optimization of intelligent production lines. This study has important theoretical and practical significance for improving machining quality, reducing costs and improving enterprise competitiveness.

articleTitle: A Novel Object Detection Algorithm for UAV Aerial Images Based on YOLOX_s
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, a YOLOX_s based algorithm is used for object detection in UAV aerial images. It addresses challenges such as small objects, fuzzy features, and complex backgrounds. First, YOLOX _s algorithm inherits the advantage of feature pyramid structure of CSP-Darknet53 and utilizes the fusion of different scale feature maps to improve the detection performance of the network for different scale targets; Second, it separating anchor frame prediction from feature extraction with Decoupled Head, better utilizing the semantic information between the underlying and higher level features; finally, Anchor-Free and Advanced label assigning strategy SimOTA enable the network to obtain better training efficiency and detection accuracy. Simultaneously, it is able to plan the attribution of the targets from the global perspective, which to a certain extent solves the problem of the fuzzy and overlapping anchor frames. Experimental results show that the improved algorithm achieves 37.5 mAP on COCO dataset, outperforming popular algorithms like SSD, yolov3, yolov8, etc., by an average of 23.46% mAP.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Modeling Technology for Commercial Aerospace Launch Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at overcoming the difficulties of actual test and demonstration in commercial space launch missions and the lack of visualized analysis tools, this paper studies the digital modeling technology for commercial space launch, and proposes solutions to problems such as multi-module parallel assembly testing with short intervals, spatiotemporal coordination for comprehensive process and technical interface matching etc. Models for the analysis and calculation of explosion range, noise impact, and geological environment are created, which has achieved quick customization and flexible assembly of simulation and modeling for complex process, as well as a data evaluation model for digitalized collaboration under multiple problem domain situations, optimizing the process of space launch activities in commercial field.

articleTitle: Information Prediction of Groundwater Pollution Sources Based on Improved Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The prediction of information regarding groundwater pollution sources is a crucial prerequisite for effective control and restoration of groundwater pollution. However, the inherent complexity and uncertainty within groundwater systems often result in substantial errors and limitations when employing traditional prediction methods. In response to these challenges, this research paper proposes a novel information prediction approach for groundwater pollution sources, leveraging an enhanced random forest algorithm. This method strategically combines the global and local search capabilities of an algorithm with a groundwater flow and migration model. The objective is to predict essential details such as the location, intensity, release time, and duration of groundwater pollution sources. To enhance the convergence speed of the algorithm and the quality of solutions, the paper introduces several improvements to the random forest algorithm. The enhancements encompass the introduction of an adaptive parameter adjustment mechanism, the incorporation of various neighborhood search strategies, and the adoption of a multi-objective optimization framework. Notably, the improved random forest algorithm utilizes Sobol sequences during initialization to diversify and homogenize the solution set. Simultaneously, a crisscross strategy is employed to bolster the local search capabilities, thereby enhancing solution accuracy and stability. Validation of the proposed method is conducted through both numerical experiments and real-world case analyses. The findings affirm the effectiveness and superiority of the enhanced random forest algorithm. Moreover, the research establishes the feasibility and practicality of this approach. The article, therefore, presents a novel concept and tool for predicting information related to groundwater pollution sources. It furnishes a scientific foundation and technical support crucial for the control and restoration of groundwater pollution.

articleTitle: Lane Detection for Autonomous Driving Based on FastSCNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Lane detection is a key task in automatic driving. In recent years, deep learning methods based on convolutional neural networks have achieved good results in semantic segmentation. In this paper, we analyze the model structure of FastSCNN, a lightweight semantic segmentation network, focus on the performance of FastSCNN in the lane line detection task, and compare it with four other classical models. The experiments prove that FastSCNN is far superior to the other models in terms of real-time performance while ensuring higher accuracy, making it an ideal choice for the lane line detection task. Finally, FastSCNN is successfully deployed to a local PC to simulate in-vehicle real-time lane line detection via a camera with a real-time FPS of 7.37 img/s.

articleTitle: Relative Orientation Algorithm Based on Essential Matrix Factorization and its Application
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In close range industrial photogrammetry, handheld cameras generally need to take a large number of photos from multiple angles and positions, making the relative poses between stations complex and unchanged. Therefore, this article proposes a relative orientation algorithm based on essential matrix factorization, which effectively solves the problem of relative orientation between camera stations. Firstly, based on the coplanar conditions in photogrammetry, the relationship between the essential matrix and the two types of parameters of relative orientation, namely the rotation matrix Euler angle and translation vector, is derived; Secondly, a method for calculating the essential matrix from the fundamental matrix is provided. Finally, the unique solutions of the rotation matrix and translation vector are obtained through singular value decomposition. The photogrammetric experiment on the large-sized surface of the box confirmed the effectiveness of the orientation algorithm proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Rapid Detection and Crack Recognition Algorithm for Highway Pavement Based on Feature Space
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Road surface detection is an important indicator for evaluating road conditions. Once defects appear on the road surface, it can lead to disasters in road traffic. Common road surface detection methods rely on manual visual inspection, which has problems such as low recognition accuracy and difficulty in identifying potential risks. In recent years, with the continuous development of visual technology, the application of image recognition technology in road surface detection has emerged. In order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of crack recognition on highways, a rapid detection and crack recognition algorithm based on feature space is proposed. This algorithm improves on the existing KPCA algorithm by introducing a decentralized matrix, thereby reducing the complexity of image processing. Simulation results show that the improved algorithm achieves an accuracy rate exceeding 95.5%, with an execution efficiency within 23.739 seconds, and the system memory usage is relatively stable. The application of this algorithm provides new technical means for rapid detection and crack recognition of highway pavement.

articleTitle: Application Research of Machine Learning Algorithms in Big Data Mining and Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Student information mining plays a significant role in student management, yet existing information management methods are relatively outdated. Machine learning algorithms have the capability to predict future trends based on historical data. Whether it's sales forecasting, stock price prediction, weather forecasting, or disease spread prediction, machine learning algorithms can leverage big data for training, thereby enhancing prediction accuracy and reliability. This paper proposes the use of machine learning algorithms for clustering analysis of student information. Currently, the LSTM algorithm suffers from runtime issues. Hence, we propose improvements to the LSTM algorithm. We introduce the Grey Wolf algorithm into the existing algorithm to construct one with fast convergence speed and high prediction accuracy. Applying the improved algorithm to student information clustering, experimental results demonstrate a significant improvement in the accuracy of student information identification.

articleTitle: A Design of an Over-Temperature Protection Circuit Based on Hysteresis Comparison
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The chip will cause irreversible damage. Over-temperature protection circuit plays an important role in improving the reliability of the chip. This paper designs an over-temperature protection circuit (OTP). The function of the negative temperature coefficient voltage is detecting the temperature, finally the high and low threshold values witch is realized through the comparator output and the shaping of the inverter. In order to ensure the stability of the reference voltage, besides, the reference circuit for low-temperature drift is designed. At the same time, the feedback structure is introduced to realize the hysteresis function and prevent the thermal oscillation phenomenon. Based on the 0.18 μm BCD process design and relevant simulation verification, the results show, at the tt process angle, the reference coefficient is about 51.26ppm/°C, when the temperature reaches 183.44°C, the output is high level, the chip stops working; when the temperature decreases to 173.65°C, the output is low level, when the chip works normally, and the delay is 9.79°C. Under different process angles and power supply voltage conditions, the deviation value meets the design requirements and the circuit has high stability.

articleTitle: A Feature Extraction Intelligent Music Genre Classification Method Based on Deep Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In the task of music genre classification, feature extraction and classifier modeling are the two key parts that directly affect the classification accuracy. In the traditional classification method, the feature extraction and classification processes are designed separately. First, the features are extracted manually from the original music signal, and then a reasonable classifier is selected to build a model and classify the extracted features. Although the traditional methods have achieved good results in many classification tasks, the feature extraction process is complex and difficult to achieve, and the features required for different classification tasks need to be specially designed, and the extracted features lack of universality. With the successful application and continuous development of deep learning models in other fields, more and more studies begin to use music spectra as the input of deep learning models to classify music genres. However, so far, the accuracy of existing classification methods based on deep learning is not ideal, so this paper mainly studies a classification method based on deep learning to improve the classification accuracy of music genre classification model. In this paper, a parallel structured deep attention classification model is proposed. By training BRNN, it can automatically learn music features from samples. The linear attention model calculates the attention probability distribution on this feature according to the learned features, and reassigns it to the feature representation. Finally, the classification is realized according to the eigenvectors with different weights. Besides the linear attention model with simple structure, a CNN attention model with stronger learning ability is also designed. In order to verify the feasibility and validity of the model, validation experiments were conducted on two standard datasets, GTZAN and Extended Ballroom. The experimental results show that the classification model based on deep parallel attention mechanism has good classification robustness, and the accuracy of classification based on BRNN and parallel CNN attention model reaches 92.7% on Extended Ballroom data set, which is better than the existing classification method based on deep learning. The validity and feasibility of the classification model are proved.

articleTitle: A High-Voltage Pre-Regulator Circuit for Wide-Input LDO
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at the application environment of LDO chip in automotive electronic system, a high voltage pre-regulator circuit is proposed, which converts the input high voltage into stable low power supply voltage to power the low voltage module inside the LDO chip. The circuit can be started normally after the bias current is established, and can quickly respond to transient changes in the external input of the automotive electronic system and perform negative feedback adjustment to obtain a stable pre-regulation voltage. The simulation results show that the input voltage range of the circuit can reach 40V high voltage, only 0.5mV changes in the change of input voltage 3~40V. The maximum load is 2.8mA. The loop is stable with a phase margin of 50°, and there is only a small overshoot and fast stability when the input voltage occurs a transient jump of about 30V.

articleTitle: Raster Map Modelling Method and Application for UAV-Intelligent Robot Cooperative Inspection Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the upgrading of voltage level, the electromagnetic environment of large-scale hub substations and the electrical, thermal, and force problems of power equipment are becoming increasingly prominent, and lean inspection is crucial. However, to cope with substation inspection scenarios with serious electromagnetic interference, the path nodes planned by the traditional grid method (TGM) are too many and cannot maintain a certain safety distance from obstacles. Therefore, this paper proposes a grid graph modeling method applicable to UAV (unmanned aerial vehicle)-intelligent robot cooperative inspection path planning. First, the raster is generated based on the actual substation layout structure, and then the vertices of the obstacle raster are extracted as feature points as new alternative points to plan the path. Then the artificial potential field (APF) method improved by large neighborhood search (LNS) is used to construct the UAV-intelligent robot cooperative inspection path optimization model. The results show that the new raster modeling method can be applied to the path planning of the improved Artificial Potential Field method, and the path can be optimized to make the inspection safer, especially for the operation of the UAV, and can improve the convergence speed of the algorithm, which is better than the traditional raster modeling method in terms of the comprehensive performance.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction and Application of Visual Inspection System for Power Tools Based on Image Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The visual inspection of electric tools in our country shows the characteristics of backward inspection equipment and low reliability. In this paper, a visual inspection system for electric tools based on image recognition technology is introduced. The system uses machine vision sensors to collect images of the object under test, the original data is sent to the image recognition and detection module, which is composed of machine vision image algorithm and depth learning related image technology. At the same time, the visual detection project is modeled and analyzed by using image acquisition technology, and the hardware and software of the detection and control system for electric tools are described emphatically, including the motor, image acquisition, and its related applications have been analyzed and studied.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Level Collaborative Interactive Technology for Electricity Power Balance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the construction of a new power system with a high proportion of new energy, the balance characteristics, analysis methods, and response strategies of the power system will undergo significant changes. Both supply and demand sides and system regulation resources are highly uncertain, and the system balance mechanism changes from “deterministic power generation tracking uncertain load” to “two-way matching between uncertain power generation and uncertain load.” The traditional balance model of “inter-provincial gateway determination and intra-provincial source-load movement” is no longer applicable. It is significantly more difficult to effectively deal with the uncertainty of new energy output, ensure reliable power supply, and maximise the consumption of clean energy. For this reason, a three-level coordinated whole-network power balancing analysis system of the State Network and Provinces is proposed, which will provide the basis for the technology and framework for the future balance of the new type of power system.

articleTitle: Road Vehicle Detection Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: To address the challenges of low accuracy in vehicle detection for small targets, occluded targets, and scenes with limited lighting conditions, this paper proposes a vehicle detection method based on YOLOv7. Firstly, a pyramid pooling structure incorporating depth-wise separable and dilated convolution modules is constructed to allow the model to integrate contextual information while enlarging the receptive field and reducing the parameter count. Next, parallel channel-spatial attention modules are designed to eliminate interference caused by serial connections. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed detection model achieves an average precision (mAP) of 98.9% and 83.4% for mAP50 and mAP50:95, respectively. Compared to YOLOv7, this represents an improvement of 2 and 5.8 percentage points, while achieving a processing speed of 39 frames per second.

articleTitle: Sorting by Selection Method and Its Improvement
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Selection sorting is a common sorting method, which is more efficient because it exchanges data less times than bubble sorting. Selection sorting is an unstable sorting algorithm. It works by selecting the smallest element each time from the data elements to be sorted and storing it at the end of the ordered area, then continuing to find the smallest element from the remaining unsorted elements and placing it at the end of the ordered area, and so on until the data element in the unordered region is empty. This paper describes the basic selection method sorting and two improved selection method sorting<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>.

Author Keywords: The selection method of ending the sorting in advance

articleTitle: Grey Clustering Correlation Analysis of AC Contactor Closing Dynamic Performance Using Panel Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: At present, the performance evaluation of electrical products is mostly aimed at classification, and the sample data processed are mostly simple types of one-dimensional sequences. Aiming at the panel data such as “prototype number - phase angle - indicator sequence”, this paper proposed a method to determine the objective weight of indicators based on sampling data. Taking nine CJ20-25 AC contactors as research objects, grey clustering and grey correlation method were used to evaluate the dynamic response performance of prototype closing, and two evaluation results were obtained: grade division and performance ranking. This paper not only introduced a detailed evaluation procedure and formulas, but also proved the effectiveness of the method by an example. The method proposed in this paper will be suitable for the evaluation system with large sample data and will make online evaluation possible. It can also provide some solutions for overall evaluation of batch products, dynamic process control of intelligent contactors and phase angle selection of life test.

articleTitle: Pinoycchio: Unleashing the Power of OpenAI and Ensemble Models for the Detection of Government Related Filipino Fake News
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The advent of the Internet has revolutionized the dissemination of information, leading to an abundance of both legitimate and false information. This information can shape public opinion, making it crucial to know whether that information is truthful or not. This study aims to build upon previous research by incorporating the latest OpenAI technology and traditional models. This study implemented traditional machine learning models, such as Multinomial Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, and Support Vector Machine, with GPT 3.5 turbo fine-tuning. A comparison between the ensemble base model and ensemble base model with GPT3.5 was made. The researchers utilized the confusion matrix to evaluate and assess the performance of the models. The ensemble base model showed overall balanced metrics compared to the ensemble model with GPT. Furthermore, the ensemble base model showed an increase of 0.25% in accuracy as well as 0.46% increase in F1-score compared to the baseline. By ensembling traditional models, the study showed an increase of performance compared to the baseline model.

articleTitle: Influence Analysis of Dual Carbon Goals on Industrial Load Based on System Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals have been set for sustainable development and changed the behavior of energy consumption. In the phase of industrial production, the electrical load is high, and affected by the dual carbon goals. Thus, this paper proposes an influence analysis scheme of dual carbon goals on industrial load. The intensity of the government policy on decarbonization is assessed by the analytic hierarchy process (AHP). Then, the indices measuring the coupling between the low-carbon policy and industrial load is built for quantitative analysis. The system dynamic model is established to simulate the interaction between the intensity of the low-carbon policy and industrial load. A feedback loop depending on the industrial carbon emission is added to describe the changes in low-carbon policy. A case study is presented to validate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Technology and Maintenance of Train Control Center
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Train control system is one of the key technical equipment to ensure the safe operation of trains and improve transportation efficiency. It can control the whole process of train operation in real time and ensure the safe operation of trains with high speed and high density. On the basis of studying and drawing lessons from the international advanced train control system technology system and the application of key technologies, China has vigorously carried out the research and construction of Chinese Train Control System (CTCS) in combination with China's actual situation. CTCS-2 and CTCS-3 Train Control Systems are widely used in China's high-speed railways at present. CTCS-2 is a train control system based on track circuit and balise to transmit movement authority information, which is mainly used in 200 ~ 250 km/h railways; CTCS-3 train control system adopts Global System for Mobile Communications for Railway (GSM-R) wireless communication to realize two-way realtime transmission of train-ground information, which meets the requirements of high speed, high density and cross-line operation of EMUs with different speed classes on 300~350 km/h high-speed railway lines in China. This paper studies the technical realization of the ground core equipment of CTCS-2, train control center, and briefly introduces its maintenance experience.

articleTitle: An Analog Simulation Study Based on Longe-Kuta and Cellular Automata Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper will consider the interaction between the sex ratio of the research subject and the resource and environment, and build a growth model based on the Logistic model. Secondly, considering the internal competition of the subjects and the network competition with other subjects, the intra-species competition model and interspecific competition model were constructed by combining the Lotka-volterra model. Then, the migration dynamics were model considering the migration characteristics of the subjects. Finally, four models were integrated to construct ecological models of the different sex populations. Then the Longe-Kuta method is used for numerical simulation, and then the basic connections in the actual biological network are considered to establish the cellular automata model. By comparing the initial and final RGB visualization, the growth advantage of the research object is analyzed.

articleTitle: Prediction-based Motion Planning for UAV Interception
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to discuss the optimization and Simulation of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) chasing non-intelligent agent. With the rapid development of UAV technology, UAV is more and more widely used in chasing non-intelligent agent. In order to make UAV more deeply used in the field of chasing non-intelligent agent, we propose a tracking method for UAV chasing non-intelligent agent, including non-intelligent agent trajectory prediction based on Kalman continuous filter and optimization scheme for UAV global waypoint nearest to non-intelligent agent, aiming to improve UAV tracking accuracy and maximize its tracking efficiency. In addition, we also establish a simulation platform for UAV chasing non-intelligent agent, and verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method through simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Development of CSR High-Frequency Power Source Control System Based on Zynq SoC
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The high-frequency system provides energy for the accelerator beam flow, and its working status directly determines the quality of the bundle stream <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. In order to improve the stability and reliability of Lanzhou heavy ion accelerator cooling storage ring system, a power source control system based on Zynq SoC was developed. The system's hardware is based on the Xilinx company Zynq 7000 series FPGA as the core, with high-speed modulus transformation (ADC) and digital input output as the periphery. The software uses an EPICS architecture based on embedded Linux Power source control protection, cavity radio frequency voltage collection and analysis, high-frequency system failure analysis and automatic recovery, data archiving, remote human-machine interface and other functions. After testing, the control system indicators meet the needs of CSR and run stable and reliable. The control architecture and methods can be promoted to the control application of the solid power source system and other accelerators.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Image Classification Method Based on Interpretable Hyperparameter Optimization Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the refined development of industrial equipment, the health state of industrial parts such as bearing is particularly important. The analysis method of bearing fault images has also become an important issue in the direction of industrialized fault diagnosis. There are many difficulties in the analysis of fault diagnosis. In the face of strong background noise, the model is weak and the parameters have the problem of random factors. This paper is proposed to classify the bearing fault image classification method based on explanatory decision -making fusion and super-added model optimization models. This paper first conduct a two-dimensional waves change of the original one-dimensional data. Based on the wave analysis of the CMOR function, it is converted to a two-dimensional image with a variety of waves, REST NET18 and other networks for noise testing to get some network frameworks with strong robustness. Based on the network framework for super-added optimization, different group optimization algorithms (GWO, WOA, etc.) are used to compare Optimize algorithms, build a model with strong feature extraction capabilities, and use class activation mapping to make decision-making explanations. Finally, after public data verification, the model this paper obtained can cope with strong background noise, and can well overcome the random factors of setting the parameters. At the same time, the decision-making explanation of the model can be used in each problem and in the actual project.

articleTitle: License Plate Recognition System Based on Matlab
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, automobiles are becoming more and more popular in China. In this process, license plate positioning and recognition technology has become the core key of license plate recognition system. With the help of license plate positioning technology, we can accurately obtain the location information and center point of the license plate. In this paper, a license plate recognition system is studied based on MATLAB platform. The system is mainly divided into five parts: image acquisition, image preprocessing, segmentation, feature extraction and character recognition. In image acquisition, we used a high-definition CCD camera to collect vehicle images. In order to improve the clarity of the image, we use image preprocessing techniques, including graying, image enhancement, edge detection and so on. As for segmentation, we combined the methods based on color localization and morphological processing to accurately locate the license plate. For license plate feature extraction, we use vertical and horizontal projection algorithms for license plate characters. Finally, for character recognition, we employ a support vector machine (SVM) algorithm for license plate characters. The experimental results show that the system has a high recognition rate, can accurately recognize the license plate of vehicles under different lighting and weather conditions, and has a certain degree of stability and robustness. The research in this paper has certain practical application value for realizing intelligent transportation system and improving the efficiency of traffic management.

articleTitle: Loan Default Prediction Based on Logistic Regression and XGBoost Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The accurate prediction of loan default risk is of paramount importance in the financial sector. In this paper, we delve into the realm of predictive modeling by employing logistic regression and XGBoost algorithms to forecast loan default occurrences. Our methodology involves rigorous data preprocessing, including handling missing values and encoding categorical variables, followed by the training of logistic regression and XGBoost models on the refined dataset. Our experimental findings reveal that the XGBoost model surpasses logistic regression in predictive accuracy. Furthermore, through comprehensive feature importance analysis, we identify and elucidate the key determinants contributing to loan default prediction. The insights garnered from our study hold significant implications for financial institutions, offering valuable guidance in the assessment and mitigation of loan default risks, thereby fostering a more secure and stable lending environment.

articleTitle: Multi-View Stereo Reconstruction Based on Adaptive Aggregation and Coordinate Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The crux of multi-view stereo reconstruction lies in the process of feature matching. To address the challenge of suboptimal feature extraction encountered by current multi-view stereo methods when dealing with regions characterized by weak texture or non-Lambertian surfaces, resulting in unsatisfactory reconstruction outcomes, this paper introduces a novel multi-view stereo network, AC-MVSNet. This network is founded on adaptive aggregation and coordinate attention mechanisms. This method firstly introduces an adaptive aggregation module, employing deformable convolution to dynamically tailor the size and shape of the receptive field based on features of varying scales, thereby obtaining a feature representation that encompasses both global and detailed information. Subsequently, following the adaptive aggregation module, a coordinate attention module is incorporated, utilizing coordinate information to dynamically adjust the weight of channel features, thereby enhancing the network's perception of detailed features such as boundary and texture information. Experimental results on the DTU dataset demonstrate that AC-MVSNet outperforms other learning-based methods in terms of its reconstruction performance.

articleTitle: Study on the Design and Implementation Effect of Limiting and Protecting Mechanism in Nuclear Power Excitation System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This project intends to extract two representative characteristics derived from parallel excitation and multiple excitation pathways based on existing nuclear power generation systems. The main excitation circuit model of self-shunt excitation is established. Then a multichannel switch control method based on PID integrated control is proposed. The main purpose of this design is to realize the simulation of multi-channel switch and tracking in the excitation system of power station. The function characteristics of maximum current and minimum overexcitation time limit, starting value, limiting value, dynamic process constraint and parameter setting requirements are studied, and the cooperative relationship among generator protection, stator overcurrent limit and excitation variable protection is defined. Finally, a representative excitation system is built based on Rinsim software. Through the simulation of no-load and grid-connected units, it is verified that the proposed excitation system can realize the effective regulation of both side voltage and reactive power. The tracking and switching of excitation path are highlighted and the correctness of the method is verified.

articleTitle: A Programmable Packet Scheduling Method Based on Traffic Rate
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Network congestion results in high queuing delays and increased flow completion time, significantly deteriorating the quality of network services. To mitigate network congestion, this paper proposes an active queue management scheme based on traffic rate control (Traffic Rate Control based AQM, TRC-AQM), operating entirely on the modern programmable switch. TRC-AQM monitors packets' enqueuing time to predict the congestion status of a switch and uses a sliding window to calculate the relative rank of the arrival packet. Based on the congestion status and relative rank, the arrival packet is either dropped or enqueued, mitigating network congestion while providing differentiated quality of service. Experimental results show that, for flows sharing a single queue, TRC-AQM can effectively alleviate congestion, and stabilize the queue length to a very low level while maintaining high link utilization, leading to a highly reduced flow completion time for flows with high priority.

articleTitle: Automatic ICD Coding Based on Bias Removal
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The automated coding task aims to match medical text records with the corresponding International Classification of Diseases (ICD) codes to improve the efficiency and accuracy of medical record management. In the automatic coding task, existing methods often face the challenge of label bias, a problem that affects the overall performance of the model. To address this challenge, we propose a new bias removal method that aims to optimize model performance. Furthermore, we note that some samples are difficult to be recognized during the encoding process due to their complexity. Given the huge amount of data contained in the large language models, we attempted to use these models to recognize these hard samples and compared their effectiveness with our debiasing method. Test results on the MIMIC-III dataset show that we find our proposed debiasing method significantly outperforms the method that relies only on large language models in dealing with hard samples, thus confirming the effectiveness and superiority of our method.

articleTitle: A Sentiment Analysis Model Based on Text Generation-OpnionSpanT5
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: ABSA is a type of fine-grained sentiment analysis, aiming to analyze the various sentiment types of a given sentence in more detail. Currently, more and more solutions adopt Seq2Seq-based architecture to perform sentiment analysis by outputting a sentence containing the required sentiment tuples. However, there is usually a problem, that is, when capturing opinion items, there may be a problem of missing extraction when facing opinion items with span. This paper proposes a model based on the paraphrase generation method, that is, before generating the quadruple, to extract opinion items separately. A BiLSTM-CRF layer is added in front of the PARA model to extract opinion items separately, and then the opinion items and the original sentences are input into the subsequent T5 model to generate emotional interpretations. We call it OpinionSpanT5, which is effective Fixed an error that occurred when generating opinion items.

articleTitle: User Satisfaction Prediction Based on Adaptive Feature Interaction Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The timeliness of user experience research for current telecommunication operators is limited, and they overly rely on expert experience in analyzing user satisfaction, lacking exploration of deep potential characteristics of users, thereby limiting the precise perception of user experience. Therefore, this paper is based on the user satisfaction prediction problem of a certain operator enterprise in Guangdong Province, and proposes a satisfaction prediction model based on adaptive feature interaction extraction (AFIE). This model obtains high-order interaction interactions between user features through multi-head attention gating mechanism and exponential neural network structure, improving the accuracy of user satisfaction prediction. After experimental verification on the operator enterprise user dataset and two publicly available telecommunications operation datasets in the province, compared with the baseline model, this method significantly improves prediction performance.

articleTitle: Research on Internet of Things Human-Computer Interaction System Based on Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This piece delves into the realm of the Internet of Things and explores the synergy between AI technology and human-machine interaction systems. Specifically, an analysis is conducted on the core of computer AI-driven dialogue processes and associated technologies, such as automated question answering, continuous speech recognition, and text-to-speech systems. Research indicates that AI technology greatly enhances the efficiency and accuracy of these interaction systems, particularly in handling continuous streams of natural language input and output. A deeper analysis of the automated question answering system reveals its reliance on sophisticated natural language processing and knowledge graph technologies, aiming to enhance the quality of problem analysis and response generation. Similarly, the exploration of continuous speech recognition systems demonstrates their pivotal role in converting speech information into text accurately, which is vital for achieving smooth human-machine conversations. Furthermore, the analysis of text-to-speech systems highlights the natural and fluid transformation of textual information into speech output through advanced speech synthesis technology. To ensure practicality and the actual effectiveness of the design, a series of system validation tests are proposed and implemented in this study. These tests evaluate the core performance indicators of the system, with recognition rate tests focusing on the accuracy of speech and text processing, while communication distance tests ensure stable connectivity between base stations and IoT nodes. Through this comprehensive validation, the research findings demonstrate the efficient performance and reliability of this human-machine interaction system in IoT applications.

articleTitle: A Malicious Domain Name Detection Method Based on Variational Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Malicious domain names are a critical area of focus within cybersecurity research. The detection and analysis of these domains are crucial for thwarting network attacks and preventing fraud, thereby safeguarding user security and data privacy. Addressing the issues related to the sparse occurrence of malicious domain names within specific Domain Generation Algorithm (DGA) families, and the challenges in detecting them in other families, this study proposes a novel method for identifying malicious domain names using a Variational Autoencoder (VAE). This approach begins by preprocessing the domain name under investigation, eliminating extraneous and irrelevant details, and normalizing the data. Subsequently, the Word2vec technique is employed to convert the domain name into a vector, which is then fed into the VAE network. The model's optimal weights are determined by optimizing the objective function through backpropagation. Next, the mean and variance derived from sampling the latent space are utilized to compute the reconstruction probability. A threshold-based classifier is subsequently applied to categorize the domain names into either legitimate or malicious categories. The method is trained and tested using datasets from Cisco and the 360 open lab. Experimental outcomes demonstrate that this method achieves a high level of detection accuracy, confirming its robust performance and effectiveness in recognizing challenging or infrequently occurring malicious domain families.

articleTitle: Mechanical Assembly Parts Recognition Technology Based on Yolov5 Target Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of automatic identification of mechanical assembly parts in industrial production lines, this paper proposes a common mechanical assembly part nut, screw and washer recognition technology based on Yolov5 target detection algorithm. In the data preparation stage, the training set and verification set of three categories of nuts, bolts and gaskets are formed by collecting pictures of nuts, bolts and gaskets on the Internet and take pictures of different angles. In order to improve the adaptability of the data set to the Yolov5 target detection algorithm, the photos of the data set are subjected to random exposure, Gaussian noise, and image rotation. The Labelimg tool in Python is used to label the data set to form a TXT file containing the location information of the label prediction box. Based on Python (3.8) and Pycharm compiler, the training and verification network of Ylolv5 target detection algorithm is constructed.
