In ViGO model, gull optimization algorithm is used to optimize the key links of ViT such as hyperparameter setting and weight initialization, aiming to improve the learning process and convergence speed of the model, and improve its generalization performance under limited resources. Through the organic integration of ViT and Seagull optimization algorithm, ViGO model not only inherits the powerful function of ViT in image recognition, but also solves the problem of training complexity and resource requirements with the help of Seagull optimization algorithm, so that the model can achieve higher recognition accuracy and faster training speed under small data sets and limited computing power environment. The successful construction and application of this new ViGO model not only promotes the progress of artificial intelligence image recognition technology, but also provides a new idea and methodology for future deep learning model design and optimization, which has a wide range of practical application value and far-reaching academic influence.

articleTitle: Research on Fruit Detection Algorithms for Picking Robots in Complex Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The most suitable RGB space was selected by analyzing 11080 apple images in RGB, HSI and Lab color spaces. Image preprocessing was carried out using Gaussian filtering thereby improving the image quality. Each apple in the preprocessed image was labelled with its ripeness category using LabelImg software, and training and test sets were created. A ripeness estimation model based on YOLOv5s deep learning was established, the weights were optimised using the SGD algorithm, and the YOLOv5s detection algorithm was used to classify apple ripeness and predict the number of apples. After testing, the accuracy of the model reaches 0.91, the recall rate reaches 0.89, and the IOU reaches 0.74, which has good accuracy.

articleTitle: Improved VVO Algorithm Based on Multi-Node Voltage Sensitivity Control in Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The increasing prevalence of distributed photovoltaic (PV) and energy storage systems in distribution networks, coupled with the rising load fluctuations, has led to an elevated risk of voltage violations at network nodes. This study investigates methods to enhance the controllability of node voltages based on the Voltage and Var Optimization (VVO) algorithm. While theoretically VVO can yield favorable outcomes in voltage limit regulation, its control process heavily relies on the objective function and optimization algorithm. Due to its intricate nonlinearity and multi-objective optimization, maintaining accuracy in voltage regulation on a global scale is not a trivial task. Therefore, a sensitivity-based improved VVO algorithm is proposed to compute real-time actions for energy storage and Line Voltage Regulator (LVR), aiming for more precise voltage control. The VVO algorithm is an approach for voltage and reactive power optimization in power systems, adjusting the reference values of reactive power in the grid to achieve optimal distribution of voltage and reactive power. However, it may converge to local minima and fail to reach a global optimum. To address this issue, an enhanced VVO algorithm is introduced to optimize the actuation of control devices. Initially, the consistency between topology modeling of power flow and actual consumption data is verified to ensure the accuracy of line parameters. Subsequently, a control strategy involving the participation of sensitivity for all node voltages is proposed to prevent device actions from getting trapped in local optima. Through this approach, a novel voltage control method named Improved VVO (IVVO) is constructed. The results demonstrate that IVVO outperforms VVO, exhibiting the fastest algorithm convergence speed, minimal reactive and active control quantities for energy storage, and the lowest line active and reactive losses. In comparison with common voltage control models such as Clustered Real-Time Adaptive Model-Based Control (MBC) and Second-Order Oscillating Particle Swarm Optimization with Constriction Factor (SOOPSO), the proposed IVVO demonstrates superior overall performance in terms of convergence speed, highest and lowest voltage accuracy, and energy storage active and reactive variations, with values of 11 iterations, 0.001%, 0.003%, 5.409 kVar, and 4.574 kW, respectively.

articleTitle: The Group-Based Distributed Auction Algorithms for Multi-Robot Task Assignment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In recent years, the optimization of multi-robot systems for tasks such as delivery of goods has gained significant attention in the field of robotics. This paper presents a detailed comparative analysis of central and distributed algorithms, focusing on how the Distributed Auction Algorithm (DAA) can be effectively applied to address the multi-robot minimum time problem. The central algorithms traditionally considered for such tasks are often limited by the need for a central coordinator, which can become a bottleneck both in terms of computational requirements and as a single point of failure. Conversely, distributed algorithms, like the DAA, allow for decision-making to be spread across the network of robots, potentially increasing robustness and scalability. Our study involves extensive simulations and real-world experiments to evaluate the performance of both algorithmic paradigms. We have meticulously recorded the total time taken by a fleet of robots to deliver goods to a predetermined location, as well as the average computation time required by each algorithm. The results are displayed in tabular form, facilitating a direct comparison across different metrics. The findings confirm that the DAA not only reduces the total delivery time but also demonstrates a significant improvement in computation efficiency. This paper not only substantiates the effectiveness of the Distributed Auction Algorithm through empirical evidence but also discusses the theoretical underpinnings that contribute to its superior performance. By highlighting the trade-offs between central and distributed approaches, we aim to provide insights that will guide the development of more efficient algorithms for multi-robot systems in similar applications.

articleTitle: Efficient Object Recognition of a Deep Dive into Computer Vision Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to achieve efficient object detection, this study delves deeply into computer vision techniques, focusing on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) trained by Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) optimization. The empirical case study employs a comprehensive methodology that comprises several datasets, meticulous preprocessing procedures, and innovative model designs that incorporate attention mechanisms and meta-learning strategies. After a detailed examination of hyperparameter optimization, Experiment 4 is demonstrated to be a consistently high-performing configuration across a variety of metrics, datasets, and adversarial circumstances. The cross-dataset evaluation demonstrates the models' generalization ability, and their resilience to hostile attacks suggests potential applications in sensitive security scenarios. The study's methodology adheres to current practices, providing insightful viewpoints on efficient object detection and paving the way for future advancements in computer vision.

articleTitle: Analysis of Speaker Power Control System Based on Automobile Mechanical Structure Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Cars gradually became the main means of transportation. However, every advantage has its disadvantages, and urban congestion caused by driving is becoming more and more serious. The main reason is that the driving level of drivers in our country is generally low, and the growth rate of vehicles is much higher than the road construction speed, which will inevitably cause congestion. Many drivers will inevitably become irritable and honk their horns too much, and the volume of vehicle horns is currently too high. Speakers that are too loud are bound to scare pedestrians and worsen traffic congestion. Therefore, we must conduct necessary research on noise. In order to ensure that the sound of car horns cannot only alert pedestrians and attract the attention of other vehicles, but also ensure the effect of bringing noise to the urban environment, many domestic experts and scholars have conducted in-depth research on the types of car horns. There are some characteristics of sound. Research has found that the sound of the whistle is closely related to the power of the speaker. Therefore, according to the mechanical structural characteristics of the car, this paper designs a power control system including a power module, ranging module, main control system and display alarm system. The main control system is the core of the entire power system, mainly completing the collection, output, display and alarm system control of signals. The power module mainly completes the driving work of the speaker.

articleTitle: An Image Raindrop Removal Method Based on Squeeze-Excitation and Residual Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Exceptional efficacy characterizes computer vision in industrial production practices. However, capturing images in adverse weather conditions renders subsequent algorithms susceptible to raindrop interference, leading to failure. This study employs a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) with attention mechanisms. Initially, morphological opening operation is introduced at the front end of a residual network to heighten mask extraction precision. Furthermore, the Squeeze-and-Excitation block is integrated into the traditional residual network to generate more precise attention maps. Raindrop information derived is effectively eliminated from images through the adversarial training mechanism within the GAN. Experimental evaluations conducted on standard and real-world image datasets demonstrate a significant enhancement in raindrop removal compared to multiple existing algorithms. Results indicate heightened representational capacity within the proposed network model, showcasing superior generalization across diverse scenarios, thereby proficiently achieving raindrop removal while accurately preserving background image details.

articleTitle: Research and Case Analysis of Spatial Data Optimization Method Based on Ray Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper presents an in-depth study on spatial data optimization based on ray detection algorithms. Through algorithm analysis, methods for optimizing spatial data are explored. Firstly, orthogonality and non-orthogonality relationships are established using solid geometry, and the algorithm of ray detection is employed to investigate data coverage width and the correlation between adjacent data. By utilizing a multi-index model, the variation pattern of data length with horizontal movement is calculated, and two potential optimization strategies are proposed. Secondly, for complex spatial structures, the optimization problem of data spacing is studied to balance data quality and acquisition efficiency. This research provides insightful solutions for similar problems and offers valuable guidance in the field of spatial data optimization.

articleTitle: Emotion Recognition Method Based on EEG Signals: 4D-CapsBLnet Model Integrating Spatio-Temporal Features
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Emotion recognition technology based on electroencephalogram (EEG) signals has become a focal point for experts and scholars globally. To improve the accuracy of machine understanding of human emotions, this paper characterizes the multidimensional information features in EEG signals, and solves the problem of 4-dimensional fusion of temporal, frequency and 2D spatial features of EEG signals, and we present a novel method named 4D-CapsBLnet. First, we transformed the multidimensional features from various channels into 4D structures for training the deep learning model. Second, we utilized Capsule Networks (CapsNet) to capture spatial and frequency information from each temporal slice of 4D inputs, while Bidirectional Long Short- Term Memory Networks (Bi-LSTM) was employed to capture temporal dependencies. To comprehensively assess the model's performance, we conducted a five-fold cross-validation with a maximum epoch limit and early stopping strategy. The average accuracy and standard deviation on the SEED, SEED-IV, and SEED-V datasets are 95.06% ± 1.65%, 88.47% ± 1.74%, and 88.23% ± 1.12%, respectively. Compared to similar research methods, the proposed model in this paper demonstrates robustness and superior performance in emotion recognition tasks.

articleTitle: Research on Signal Source Sweeping Instrument Based on Three in One Oscilloscope
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the development of the electronics industry, the demand for oscilloscope signal sources and other instruments is still greatly increasing. In response to the existing equipment's problems in accuracy, price, portability, and other aspects, this study proposes a user-friendly and portable three in one oscilloscope signal source frequency sweeper designed using STM32 control integrated DDS chip AD9910 output. It can be easily used in various non-laboratory or low precision environments. The close combination of built-in ADC and AD9910 in STM32 enables STM32 to exert powerful performance and extremely high speed, and demonstrates excellent accuracy and innovation in oscilloscopes, signal sources, and frequency scanners. We believe that this system has better application prospects and can be widely used in instrument measurement in various simple environments.

articleTitle: Perspective-Based Motion Planning for UAV Interception
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Single-aircraft pursuit missions of UAVs are becoming increasingly important in modern military and civil domains, and these missions require UAVs to be able to autonomously recognize, track and approach moving targets. In this paper, we study the technology of UAV single-aircraft pursuit of agent, and propose a motion planning model based on the characteristics of the motion model of movable agent. The model realizes the prediction of the future trajectory of the agent by analyzing the movement law of the agent, which provides decision support for UAV chasing. Meanwhile, we also proposes a trajectory optimization strategy based on the maximization of UAV chase perspective, which improves the chase efficiency by optimizing the flight traj ectory of the UAV. In order to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model and strategy, we constructs a simulation platform based on ROS (Robot Operating System) for UAVs chasing agent, and tests and verifies the proposed model and strategy by simulating the scenario of UAVs chasing agent. The experimental results show that the proposed model and strategy can effectively improve the chasing efficiency and success rate of UAVs, which provides strong support for the application of UAVs in the field of agent chasing.

articleTitle: Research on Power System Design Optimization Based on Dynamic Cutting Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper aims to explore the optimization design and analysis for enhancing the efficiency of power systems. The quantification of the energy both prior to and after successful power system is undertaken. In this view, the variables which impact power system efficency are discerned. Guided by the principles of the system, we carry out modeling and analysis, employing dynamic cutting methods and Gaussian function simulations to optimize power conversion efficiency. Ultimately, through the established model analysis, we derive the factors that influence the optimal efficiency parameters within the power system. This research contributes to the broader goal of developing more sustainable and efficient energy systems for future generations.

articleTitle: Research on Goal Planning Problem Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Genetic algorithm as a powerful heuristic optimization algorithm excels in complex problems and global optimization. The aim of this study is to deeply explore the application of genetic algorithm in optimization problems and fully analyze its significance and effectiveness in several fields. Genetic algorithms represent solutions in the problem space as individuals by modeling the basic principles of biological evolution, and generate new generation solutions through crossover, mutation and other operations. Its application in complex problem solving is of wide significance, not only efficiently searching the problem space, but also dealing with complex situations such as multi-objectives and multi-constraints, which provides feasible optimization solutions for practical problems. The study adopts a typical genetic algorithm process, including individual representation, selection, crossover, mutation and other operations. By adjusting the algorithm parameters, adaptive optimization is achieved and the robustness of the algorithm is improved. In the example study, the optimal path is found by genetic algorithm, taking into account both path length and time constraints. Satisfactory results were obtained through the example study. The optimized path meets the minimization requirement of length, which proves the effectiveness of genetic algorithm in solving practical problems. The powerful performance of genetic algorithm in solving complex optimization problems is demonstrated, which provides useful insights for further research and application.

articleTitle: Analysis and Assessment of Frequency Regulation Characteristics of Joint Wind-Storage System Based on Predicted Wind Speed and Load
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the aggravation of environmental pollution, the wind power gradually replaces traditional thermal power, which makes the electric system develop towards the new electric system with renewable energy sources operating as the essential body. However, under high penetration of wind power, the stability of the system cannot be guaranteed, and the fluctuation of wind speed and load, as well as the weak inertia of the wind turbines, bring great challenges to the frequency of the grid. Therefore, this paper uses the Double Fed Induction Generator (DFIG) and battery energy storage (BES) to support the frequency, and puts forward the frequency regulation strategy of the combined wind-storage system with different wind speeds. At the same time, considering the uncertainty of wind speed and load, Monte Carlo and k-means clustering reduction scenarios are used to predict wind speed and load for a period of time, and the comprehensive index system is established to evaluate the frequency regulation ability of the combined wind-storage system when wind speed and load fluctuations occur. Finally, simulink was used to build the joint wind-storage system model and an example of frequency regulation control strategy. The simulation and assessment were carried out when three kinds of disturbances occurred, respectively, to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the combined wind-storage frequency regulation scheme, so as to better adapt to the challenges of wind speed fluctuations and load changes.

Author Keywords: frequency regulation strategies of different wind speeds

articleTitle: Path Planning of UGV via Deep Reinforcement Learning with Observation Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs) have emerged as a cost-effective unmanned vehicle and have found extensive applications in various fields, and traditional UGV path planning algorithms rely on a comprehensive understanding of the environment and accurate UGV modeling, leading to limited generalization capabilities. In this paper, we propose a UGV path planning algorithm which based on reinforcement learning method to enable autonomous navigation in partially observation environment. We first introduce the Duel Deep Q-Network algorithm to model UGV path planning tasks, including designing the space of action and state, and reward function. Then, to address the challenge of inefficient UGV path planning in complex environments due to incomplete perception, we incorporate a recurrent prediction module into the algorithm. This module enhances the memory of temporal perception information of the UGV, effectively complementing the current state information and supporting efficient UGV path planning in complex environments. To demonstrate the efficacy of the presented algorithm, we design a typical UGV path planning scenario. Comparative analysis with baseline algorithms demonstrates that our method ensures higher path planning capability for UGV in complex environments.

articleTitle: Table of Contents
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)

articleTitle: Research and Application of Multimodal Data Fusion Technology for Oil and Gas Pipelines
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the advent of the era of big data and artificial intelligence, pipeline enterprises are accumulating increasingly rich data. However, currently in the oil and gas pipeline industry, traditional pipeline data processing technologies are mostly aimed at single modal data, which can no longer meet the data needs of big data technology and artificial intelligence technology. Further research on multimodal data fusion technology for pipeline business scenarios is needed. Firstly, this paper investigates the current status of pipeline data fusion technology at home and abroad, constructs a pipeline big data technology architecture, analyzes the sources and types of pipeline data, and systematically elaborates on pipeline multimodal data fusion technology, including data conversion and fusion, logical association fusion, spatial analysis and fusion, semantic feature fusion. Secondly, the paper proposes a pipeline data lake technology architecture, providing services for subsequent data storage and analysis. Finally, this paper proposes that in the future, it is necessary to meet the data needs of new generation artificial intelligence technologies such as large models, and further research and application of multimodal data fusion technology should be carried out.

articleTitle: The Exploration of a Multi-Level Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Based on the exploration of a multilevel fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, this paper investigates the application of the principles of fuzzy mathematics and combines the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) with fuzzy theory to conduct multilevel fuzzy comprehensive assessments. During the study, Various data processing tools, such as Excel, MATLAB, and SPSS, are employed. After initial preprocessing and selection, mathematical models are developed through multidimensional processing and statistical analysis. By integrating the Isolation Forest algorithm with the ARIMA model, abnormal values in the collected data are successfully eliminated. It also avoids the possibility of erroneously deleting normal data by the Isolation Forest model. Taking into account the time series effects among the potential variables, LSTM time series prediction model is ultimately chosen, mitigating the drawbacks of traditional RNN neural networks, such as gradient vanishing and exploding. By applying the model corresponding to the actual problem, the multilevel fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is discussed.

articleTitle: Application of PSO Algorithm in Optimizing BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: BP neural network is a widely used means in the field of data prediction, and it is very important to improve the fitting ability and prediction ability of BP neural network to nonlinear problems in practical application. Aiming at the problems of slow convergence, low accuracy and poor fitting effect of traditional BP neural network, this paper proposes the PSO-BP model of BP neural network with PSO algorithm. This model uses the PSO algorithm to find the optimal parameter group for the BP neural network for the best model performance. Comparing this model with the BP model, the results show that the PSO-BP model is about 5% and 40% better in goodness of fit and prediction accuracy, respectively, which provides a useful scheme for data prediction research.

articleTitle: Design of Handling Robot Based on OpenMV and Intelligent Tracking System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: At present, there is a labor-intensive problem in transportation industries such as supermarkets, which leads to low work efficiency. In order to improve the current situation of the transportation industry, it is necessary to design a handling robot that can complete recognition, tracking, and grasping tasks. Therefore, this article designs a handling robot that can complete the tasks of object recognition, intelligent tracking, and object grasping and placement. Object recognition uses an OpenMV camera with high recognition accuracy. The intelligent tracking adopts the OPS-9 planar positioning system, which has high positioning accuracy. The object is grasped and placed using a six joint robotic arm, and the accuracy of grasping and placing can meet the task requirements. The results show that the handling robot can effectively complete the handling task and improve the efficiency of handling work.

articleTitle: Aspect-Level Sentiment Analysis Based on the Convolutional Neural Network and Positional Enhancement Vectors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The Aspect-Lased Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) is able to effectively extract key information helpful for decision-making from a large amount of user-generated content currently available on various Internet platforms by predicting the sentiment polarity of a given aspect word in a sentence. Existing studies usually ignore the positional information of the context on the relative distance of aspectual words, resulting in models that may focus on irrelevant words. In this paper, we hypothesize that the positional weight of the context (i.e., words closer to the aspect word are more important) has a positive effect on the sentiment bias judgments of aspectual words, and we propose a mechanism for capturing the positional information, i.e., positional weight encoding, to further improve the prediction accuracy of the affective tendencies corresponding to aspectual words. In this paper, the dynamic word vector representation is obtained using the BERT model and fused by the proposed positional weights to obtain the positionally enhanced word vector representation, and then the textual semantic features are extracted using dual-channel networks. Experiments show that the accuracy and F1 value of the proposed model in this paper is significantly improved on the SemEval 2014 Task 4 dataset, confirming the lifting effect of the model we studied.

articleTitle: Forecasting Housing Price Using GRU, LSTM and Bi-LSTM for California
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This study aims to address the challenge of predicting housing prices in California using various neural network models, including LSTM, Bi-LSTM, GRU, and a hybrid GRU-LSTM. To enhance predictive accuracy, an innovative approach involving spatial sequences based on Haversine is introduced. By considering the spatial correlation of housing prices, the data is spatialized, and the results demonstrate that the collaborative integration of spatial sequences and neural networks significantly improves model prediction accuracy. This not only provides a novel approach for the precise forecasting of individual housing prices but also holds potential to offer additional support for government oversight and regulation, benefiting homebuyers in understanding the complexity of the home-buying process. The findings emphasize the importance of considering spatial factors in housing price predictions, offering a promising direction for future research and practical applications in the real estate domain.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Context Aware Traffic Sign Detection Algorithm Based on YOLOV8-n
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: As the pace of intelligence progresses, research into traffic sign detection algorithms has garnered significant attention. Nevertheless, the current traffic sign detection methods face challenges such as limited environmental information perception and the absence of lightweight models. To address these issues, we introduce a lightweight context-aware traffic sign detection network, leveraging the YOLOV8-n framework. Firstly, we developed a module, termed C2f-DCA-Faster, which effectively reduces the number of network parameters while enhancing the network's capacity to capture spatial location information. This enhancement, in turn, bolsters the network's context-aware abilities. Secondly, we integrated a multi-scale module into the network's neck layer, enabling the extraction of diverse features across various spatial scales. This addition enhances the robustness of information fusion. Lastly, we employed the WIOUS loss function to constrain the regression of target positions, thereby improving the network's generalization of location information and its precision in target positioning. Experimental results on the TTIOOK traffic sign detection dataset reveal that our proposed detection model surpasses the benchmark network's average precision (mAP) by 3.8%. Furthermore, our model boasts a parameter count that is O.199G lower than the benchmark, significantly enhancing the detection accuracy of traffic road signs to meet the demands of real-time detection.

articleTitle: A New FMEA Approach with a Consensus Reaching Model Considering Bounded Confidences Based on Deep Learning Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) is a traditional methodology applied to identify, classify, and resolve system failures. In order to optimize this method, we proposed a new FMEA model by combining the consensus model with optimization feedback mechanism and the K-means algorithm. Firstly, the consensus model with optimization feedback mechanism is used to enhance consensus and mutual acceptance among experts within their bounded confidence. It is designed to maximize the similarity of the team, effectively promoting collaboration and agreement among experts. By considering experts' bounded confidence, the model measures the level of consensus in terms of expert acceptance. Next is the application of the K-means algorithm. The algorithm is used to cluster twelve faults into three categories: “most critical”, “general critical” and “least critical”. According to the clustering results, the “most critical” failure modes are prioritized for correction. Finally, an endoscopic risk assessment exercise will be used to show the feasibility and benefits of the new FMEA method.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Configuration of Parameter Variables of Hybrid Energy Storage in Microgrid Under New Energy Access
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of large load power, unreasonable distribution of energy storage device and high operating cost of micro-grid energy storage system under new energy access, the optimization allocation method of hybrid energy storage capacity of micro-grid under new energy access is studied. The conservation conditions of hybrid energy storage capacity of a new microgrid were set, parameter variables of adaptive particle swarm optimization were selected and optimized, the objective function of the hybrid energy storage capacity system of the microgrid was established, the energy storage optimization constraints were obtained, and the optimal configuration of hybrid energy storage capacity of the microgrid was realized. The experimental results show that the proposed method can reduce the operating cost of optimal configuration and improve the optimal configuration effect of standby and microgrid hybrid energy storage capacity.

articleTitle: Method for Recognizing Intrapulse Modulation Types of Radar Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper addresses the identification of various types of intra-pulse signal modulation. First, we introduce the feature differences between various radar signals. Based on the data of the signal to be tested, we identify the modulation type using methods such as Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT), digital instantaneous frequency measurement, and feature histogram. We provide the corresponding calculation process for key parameters. By combining the principled design of MATLAB and the construction of the SYSTEM GENERATOR model, we propose a new method for intrapulse identification. The effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method are validated by comparing simulation data with model data.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on the Parameterization of Automotive Power Tailgate
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The article addresses the issue of uneven performance of power tailgate equipment between different vehicle manufacturers, and proposes and analyzes the reasons for parameter calibration of power tailgate, various indicators, and various working conditions. Starting from the underlying technical principles, this paper explains the rationality of parameter calibration for anti-pinch force, running time, running smoothness, start and stop smoothness indicators, as well as the necessity of parameter calibration under different voltage, temperature, air conditioning gear, slope, and snow load conditions. This provides a reference basis for the automotive industry to improve the performance of power tailgate equipment in the future.

Author Keywords: Power tailgate parameter calibration working conditions

articleTitle: An Ensemble Approach for Bundle Recommendation Based on Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that an individual bundle recommendation approach is prone to producing recommendation bias and has poor generality, we propose an ensemble approach for bundle recommendation based on performance evaluation. First, we propose an ensemble bundle recommendation framework, which integrates the predictive power of multiple base recommenders to improve the bundle recommendation performance. Second, we train the base recommenders in the ensemble on the training set and endow them with importance weights according to their performance evaluation on the validation set. Finally, we propose two bundle recommendation strategies for the ensemble and aggregate the recommendation lists generated with these two strategies in a weighted manner. Experiments show that the average improvement of recall@K and NDCG@K for our ensemble approach over state-of-the-art methods is 3.82% and 7.39%, respectively.

articleTitle: The Prediction and Investigation of Factors in the Adaptability Level of Online Learning Based on AutoML and K-Means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This study applies advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) tool to analyze 1,205 students, aiming to enhance adaptability prediction and identify key influencing factors. Using K-means clustering, students were categorized into two groups, revealing distinct learning behaviors and characteristics. Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) technology, utilizing Baidu's EasyDL, predicted online learning adaptability for each group, which is assessed by various performance indicators. The results demonstrated that the accuracy of adaptability prediction for the two groups, Cluster_0 and Cluster_1, was 91.3% and 98.1%, respectively. The performance indicator analysis reveals the superiority of Cluster_1 in predicting high adaptability levels, while Cluster_0 performed poorly in the high-high category. The importance scores of key factors further reveal the multidimensional factors affecting students' adaptability to online learning. For instance, in Cluster_0, the top three key factors are Location, IT Student, and Load-shedding, while in Cluster_1, they are Internet Type, Device, and Financial Condition. An in-depth comparative analysis of the factors in both groups highlighted the significant impact of students' gender and age on their adaptability levels. Therefore, in the practical application of the predictive model, personalized analysis and intervention should be conducted according to the specific characteristics of different groups.

articleTitle: Sequence Modeling and Feature Fusion for Multimodal Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition (MER) refers to the recognition and understanding of emotional states from multiple types of data (e.g., audio, and video, etc.). MER in applications such as human-computer interaction, virtual assistants, and social media, an accurate understanding of user emotions can lead to smarter and more personalized services. For example, virtual assistants can better understand the emotional needs of users and provide responses that are more in line with user expectations. However, the existing multimodal emotion recognition research based on LSTM method has poor modeling ability for speaker context dependence, interlocutor temporal order, and dialogue context. This paper presents a novel approach for detecting multi-modal emotion features using Transformers, specifically designed for tracking emotions in dialogue. Furthermore, the multi-attention mechanism is used to emphasize the effective information, and the context global information of the data is fully paid attention to form the semantic visual related features of multi-level attention mechanism fusion. Finally, the three modalities are effectively fused at the decision level to achieve emotion recognition with high accuracy and strong generalization ability, and improve the model's ability to understand complex scenes. On the IEMOCAP dataset, our proposed method achieves the best emotion recognition results among the comparison methods.

articleTitle: An Improved Moving Target Detection Algorithm Based on Background Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to achieve rapid and efficient moving target detection, an improved moving target detection algorithm for background modeling is proposed. Firstly, the first frame is selected as the initial background images from the video images' sequence. Then, we read the continuous N+1 frames of images and use the frame different methods to generate N different images and different background images. Next, the rectangular radial basis function is introduced to count the number of differences within the rectangular width in each different image, and select the pixel value of the original image corresponding to the differential image with the maximum frequency as the reference background. Finally, accurate and complete moving targets are extracted by the different background method. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can reconstruct highly reliable background images and exhibit excellent performance and robustness in moving target detection. This not only improves the detection efficiency of moving targets, but also provides a new powerful tool for research and application in related fields.

articleTitle: Intelligent Optimization of Line Parameters Based on the Inverse Problem of Spatial Electric Field Strength for Ultra-High Voltage AC Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This article proposes a method based on intelligent optimization calculation of line parameters for the inverse problem of spatial electric field strength of ultra-high voltage AC transmission lines. Traditional transmission line design methods mainly rely on experience and trial and error, which have problems of low efficiency and unstable design results. To solve this problem, this paper combines genetic algorithm and finite element method to establish the mapping relationship between line parameters and spatial electric field strength, and proposes an optimization algorithm based on genetic algorithm. Through iterative calculation and fitness evaluation, the optimal combination of line parameters is found. Based on the geometric shape of the transmission line and the electrical characteristics of the wires, the finite element method is used to numerically simulate the electric field distribution of the transmission line, and the spatial electric field strength is optimized as the objective function. By using mathematical formulas and numerical calculations, a mapping relationship between line parameters and spatial electric field strength has been established, providing a foundation for subsequent optimization calculations. By simulating natural selection, genetic variation, and gene crossover, it seeks the optimal solution to a problem. In this article, genetic algorithm is applied to the optimization calculation of line parameters, gradually optimizing the values of line parameters through steps such as population initialization, fitness calculation, selection operation, crossover operation, and mutation operation, with the goal of minimizing the spatial electric field strength [1]. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this article can effectively reduce the spatial electric field strength of the transmission line, improve the safety and stability of the transmission line. Meanwhile, this article also analyzed the convergence and stability of the algorithm, verifying its feasibility and effectiveness [2].

articleTitle: Study of Decision-Making for Plants Survive Droughts Based on Lotka-Volterra Prediction Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: When plant populations suffer from drought, different species exhibit different drought tolerance. Studies have shown that communities with different numbers of species also behave differently in response to drought. In this paper, we simulate the process and results of plant communities coping with drought by building mathematical models and combining biological knowledge. Considering the interactions among different species in the community, the Lotka-Volterra model was used to describe the competitive relationships among five species and to predict the community dynamic trends. It was used together with the precipitation model to construct The “Plants Survive Droughts” (PSD). We used the “PSD” model to predict the dynamics of different numbers of species and different combinations of species over time. The study of this problem enables humans to understand the relationship between plant communities and the interaction of the larger environment, which helps to solve similar problems encountered in production and life.

articleTitle: Chang'e-3 Soft Landing Orbit Design and Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Chang'e-3 was successfully launched at 01:30 on December 2, 2013 and arrived at the lunar orbit on December 6th. In this paper, the soft landing of Chang'e-3 is roughly analyzed by establishing an energy balance model of the orbit as well as the theorem of universal gravitation. Through the physical analysis of Chang'e-3 in the main deceleration stage, rapid adjustment, coarse obstacle avoidance, fine obstacle avoidance, slow descent, free fall of the six stages, the use of speed and displacement formulas, we could form a system of equations to solve the acceleration and the corresponding time. And then according to Newton's second law and the impulse formula, we could find out the mass per unit of time Chang'e-3 changes, as well as the use of the integral theorem of the integration of the time to promote the generator combustion consumes the mass. The mass of Chang'e-3 is calculated by integrating the time using the integral theorem.

articleTitle: Iterative Direction Expansion of Power Flow and Convergence Analysis Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Power flow calculation is essential for optimizing control actions and analyzing the running state of power systems. The development of smart grids has led to more complex power systems, challenging the convergence and computational efficiency of conventional algorithms. This study focuses on the limitations of current power flow algorithms in terms of iteration direction and proposed a method to extend the iteration direction in power flow calculation. Moreover, this method incorporated deep learning techniques to ease the computational burden while improving the convergence. This study aims to provide a useful reference for the analysis of complex power flows in power systems.

articleTitle: Charge Simulation of XLPE Cable Based on Bipolar Carrier Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: XLPE cable is widely used in power transmission because of many advantages, high voltage direct current (HVDC) cable is greatly affected by space charge during operation. In this paper, the variation of charge density and electric field intensity distribution in XLPE cable under different working conditions is studied based on bipolar carrier transport model. The results show that in the absence of temperature gradient, the charge density growth rate of copper and XLPE junction region is significantly higher than that of other regions. When there is a temperature gradient, the overall charge distribution and electric field intensity distribution are basically the same as without temperature gradient. In the direction of XLPE cable core, the field strength increases in some areas, while the part away from the core direction decreases gradually. When the cable ages, the space charge density increases, and the increase in the density of the trap in the insulating medium leads to an increase in the charge density. The research results will provide some reference for XLPE cable operation. The innovation lies in the application of a bipolar carrier transport model to investigate the intricate details of charge density and electric field intensity in XLPE cables, particularly focusing on the challenges posed by space charge during the operation of high voltage direct current cables. The findings contribute to the knowledge base for enhancing the design and operation of XLPE cables, with potential implications for the broader field of power transmission.

articleTitle: Study on Signal Optimization of PCB Design for Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the progress of high and new technology, the application of new semiconductor materials, semiconductor components such as integrated circuits are developing towards integration and high efficiency. This development trend promotes PCB design towards high density and high efficiency. The current electronic system design generally signal frequency is higher than 100 MHz, the signal in the PCB transmission process is prone to reflection, crosstalk and other signal integrity problems. How to reduce the loss of the signal in the transmission process and ensure the integrity of the signal is the challenge of the development of high frequency high-speed wireless communication PCB. In this paper, some problems needing attention in the signal optimization processing of high density wireless communication PCB design are deeply studied, and the signal optimization processing methods and improvement measures are proposed. Using these designs can effectively reduce the noise caused by stray inductance in PCB, and help to reduce the crosstalk, reflection and electromagnetic interference between signals.

articleTitle: On Classes of Algorithms and a Meta-Algorithm for Solving the LPN Problem
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Cryptography is the cornerstone of modern cybersecurity and involves encryption and decryption techniques used to protect the confidentiality and integrity of data. As cyber attacks become increasingly sophisticated, cryptography plays a key role in the field of cyber security, protecting sensitive information from malicious attacks and theft. Among them, LPN problem is a basic problem in modern cryptography, coding theory and machine learning. This paper discusses various existing algorithms for the LPN problem, discusses their various strengths and weaknesses, categorizes these algorithms based on specific traits, and proposes a new composite algorithm combining the strengths of various algorithms in order to improve performance in specific scenarios.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Heat Shrink Tube Expansion Control System Based on PLC and Touch Screen
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Due to the high labor intensity, insufficient production automation, and low production efficiency during the process of heat shrink tube expansion, a heat shrink tube control system was designed. This system integrates the functions of pay-off, traction, heating, expansion, and cooling. The text accurately describes the hardware and software components of the system used to control the expansion process of a heat shrink tube. The language used is clear, concise, and objective, with a formal register and precise word choice. The text follows conventional academic structure and formatting, adhering to style guides and citation standards. The logical flow of information is maintained with causal connections between statements. The text is free from grammatical errors, spelling mistakes, and punctuation errors. No changes in content were made. This system utilizes PLC as the central control and employs a modular design approach. It carries out sequence control for the entire process of heat shrink tube expansion, enabling continuous operation of the system. Additionally, the touch screen serves as the host computer, allowing for real-time monitoring and parameter adjustments of the equipment. The results of the operation demonstrate that the system is stable, reliable, and easy to operate. It ensures accurate expansion of the heat shrink tube and meets both control and production requirements. The design interface is intuitive, which enhances the system's reliability and intelligence.

articleTitle: Classification of Potholed Roads Using Deep Convolutional Neural Network Model Based on AlexNet
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This research is dedicated to addressing the detection and classification of potholed roads, a problem faced in the field of traffic safety and urban maintenance today. By adopting the AlexNet model implemented in PyTorch based on deep learning, a network structure with 5 convolutional layers and 3 pooling layers has been successfully constructed, which can efficiently and accurately extract features of potholed road images. The model introduces nonlinear processing, including the Relu activation function, LRN local response normalization function, and Dropout layer, achieving precise extraction of pothole features. Furthermore, the data preprocessing of road images and optimization of the training model have achieved satisfactory accuracy on the validation set. Finally, the images to be predicted are preprocessed and input into the trained model for classification through a loop structure, ultimately achieving an accuracy rate of 91.752%. This comprehensive solution provides feasibility for automated detection and classification of potholed roads, and is expected to yield significant benefits in the fields of urban maintenance and traffic safety.

Author Keywords: AlexNet Deep Convolutional Neural Network Model

articleTitle: Study on Grade Prediction and Data Analysis in Tutorial System by Deep Learning Technology Based on Modified LSTM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper discusses the prediction of students' academic achievement and the data analysis under the tutorial system. In this study, we innovatively adopted the optimized and improved Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural network model. This deep learning algorithm effectively solved the problem of gradient disappearance and long-term dependence existing in traditional methods when processing time series data with its unique gating mechanism. By collecting and integrating historical data on a large number of students' academic performance and participation in instructor-led activities, we input these complex time series data into an improved LSTM model for training and learning. The empirical study shows that the model can effectively capture the long-term trend and short-term fluctuation affecting the change of student achievement, and accurately predict the future academic achievement of students, and its prediction accuracy is significantly improved compared with the traditional prediction model.

articleTitle: Real-Time Electromagnetic and Electromechanical Hybrid Simulation Based on RTLAB-PowerFactory
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This article proposes a heterogeneous real-time hybrid simulation method for RTLAB-PowerFactory based on the Functional Mock up Interface (FMI). Firstly, based on the Frequency Dependent Network Equivalence Method (FDNE), the electromechanical side subnetwork and electromagnetic side subnetwork are equivalently modeled. Then, the data exchange information was defined and a large step data extrapolation method was designed to achieve data exchange between models. Finally, using the written C++ software to call the Functional Mock Up Unit (FMU) file, UDP digital communication between PowerFactory and RTLAB simulator was achieved. The correctness of the designed method and simulation platform was verified through IEEE39 node system testing.

articleTitle: Statistical Research on Small Target Monostatic RCS Based on Full-Wave Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, the monostatic radar cross section (RCS) on small target is investigated using full-wave simulation. Dual-polarized RCS of three frequencies are generated and studied. The radiation properties of the target are considered according to the surface current density distributions. The statistical characteristics of frequency- and polarization-dependent RCS are analyzed. Kolmogorov-Smirnov test is applied and the fitting results show that the Gamma distribution effectively fits the three RCS variations at low frequencies and same-polarization RCS at high frequencies, while the Weibull distribution model and the log-normal distribution model demonstrate excellent fitting performance for same-polarization RCS at high frequencies.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Charging Station Location Method Based on Voronoi Diagram
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Driven by dual-carbon targets, electric vehicles are gradually replacing petroleum vehicles as the first major player in the automotive market. In order to meet the charging demand of electric vehicle users, an excellent charging pile siting strategy is needed. This paper proposes an electric vehicle charging pile siting method based on the face demand method. First, the microgrid area is modelled in a zonal manner based on the existing distribution of slow and fast charging piles. Second, the optimal charging pile layout area is determined by combining the distribution of electric vehicle users and the traffic flow in each microgrid region. Considering that there are more distributed power sources and energy storage facilities in the microgrid, the location of these distributed energy facilities needs to be considered comprehensively in the site selection process in order to minimise wind and light abandonment. Finally, an improved particle swarm algorithm is applied to simulate the case to verify the correctness of the adopted siting strategy.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Speed Estimation Method Based on a Reduce-Order Extended Kalman Filter for PMSM Sensorless Drives
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: A speed sensorless control system for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine (PMSM) by using an adaptive parallel reduce order Extended Kalman Filter is proposed in this paper. The noise matrix in the EKF algorithm is one of the important factors that determine its estimation performance, and the optimal solution of the noise matrix obtained by the traditional EKF noise matrix through trial-and-error method is often difficult to cope with the changing working conditions in reality. In addition, EKF requires complex calculations, so it has high requirements for chips, making it difficult to industrialize. Therefore, this paper proposes a novel EKF algorithm, which can not only reduce the computational complexity, but also update the noise matrix online by using the fading factor according to the actual working conditions. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Multi-Criterion OLSR Protocol Optimization Based on Network Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at the Multi-Point Relay (MPR) algorithm of the traditional Optimized Link State Routing (OLSR), the weight factor of the multi-criterion MPR algorithm depends on the subjective choice and the premise is that the criteria are independent of each other. The Analytic Network Process (ANP) was used to analyze the correlation between the three criteria and the number of nodes, the number of packets and the node speed. In view of the fact that the traditional MPR algorithm does not consider the influence of node energy and inter-node connection stability on the selection of MPR nodes, and the traditional OLSR protocol does not consider the high packet loss ratio caused by packet congestion, the remaining energy, node connection time and buffer occupancy of the nodes are selected to optimize the selection of MPR nodes. The OPNET simulation verifies that the proposed method can effectively achieve low latency and packet loss rate for the corresponding scenarios.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Design of 1E Excitation System for Emergency Nuclear Power Plant Generator
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper describes the general technical index and evaluation standard of the lE excitation system of the standby unit of nuclear power plant. The safety of excitation system is studied. The structure and operating characteristics of brushless exciter with adjustable phase compound excitation are introduced. The system has the characteristics of automatic voltage regulator for safety and additional voltage regulator without safety of brushless excitation system, which is constructed by using MATLAB software. The rated load test of sudden increase and sudden decrease of 60% was carried out. The system has good control performance. The model is verified to be correct. The numerical simulation method of the phase-compound brushless DC excitation system constructed in this project is feasible. In the simulation of sudden load and sudden load reduction, accurate conclusions are obtained, which can truly reflect the system situation. This system provides theoretical basis for optimizing the overall design and parameter setting of excitation system.

articleTitle: Research on Microblog Comment Clustering Algorithm Based on Emotional Topic Feature Word Weighting
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to improve the effect of sentiment analysis clustering on microblog comments, this paper proposes a microblog comment clustering algorithm based on the weighted sentiment topic feature words. By defining the emotional-themed word bag, we can make full use of the emotional information contained in micro-blog comments. On this basis, by weighting emotion theme feature words, this paper makes full use of the theme features among microblog comments, considers the contribution of emotion theme words to the theme, and finally obtains weighted emotion theme feature words through LDA clustering. The research results show that the algorithm has a good clustering effect for sentiment analysis and is helpful to network public opinion analysis.

articleTitle: Prediction of Cement Slurry Formulation Based on RMAPCN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Cement slurry formulation design is a very important process in cementing operations, and the performance of the formula will directly affect the quality of cementing. In traditional cementing operations, professionals perform experiments based on information from adjacent Wells to obtain fuzzy cement formulas, and then constantly adjust the final cement formula in the actual operation. This operation can cost a lot of labor and time, which is not good for real-time operation. To solve the above problems, a new forecasting model RMAPCN (IndRNN with Multi-Head Attention Mechanism and PSO-CNN) is proposed in this paper for the prediction of cement slurry formulation. The model can quickly obtain the cement slurry formulation with higher accuracy and better timeliness by mining the characteristics of the existing data information and using the well information. The comparison between the RMAPCN model and the baseline model shows that the RMAPCN model has obvious advantages in each performance index, and can be used to guide the actual cement slurry formulation design.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Vision Target Tracking Technology Based on Multi-Feature Fusion Mean Shift Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the rapid development and widespread application of computer vision technology, object tracking has become a hot research topic and holds significant value in areas such as video surveillance, autonomous driving, and virtual reality. Traditional methods of object tracking rely mainly on single features, but they exhibit instability in complex scenarios. This paper proposes an improved Mean Shift object tracking algorithm based on multi-feature fusion to overcome the limitations of traditional algorithms. Experimental results show that multi-feature fusion can more accurately capture target feature information, enhance the robustness and accuracy of object tracking, and provide new insights and methods for the further development of object tracking technology.

articleTitle: Research on a Multi-Layer Camera Calibration Method Used in Close-Range Industrial Photogrammetry
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In close range industrial photogrammetry, when using a digital camera to capture objects at different distances, the automatic focus of the lens will change the camera's intrinsic parameters, leading to measurement errors. To address the aforementioned issues, this paper proposes a multi-layer calibration method. Firstly, the principle of camera calibration based on planar checkerboard is introduced. Then, this paper discusses how camera autofocus causes changes in the main distance. Secondly, the basic idea of multi-layer camera calibration was elaborated. Finally, a multi-layer calibration experiment was conducted using a large-sized chessboard as the calibration board, revealing the inherent law of camera intrinsic parameters changing with shooting distance.

articleTitle: Research on Big Data Dimensionality Reduction Transmission of Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to reduce the dimensionality of the massive data collected by various intelligent terminals in the smart grid, this study intends to use the random forest algorithm to construct a big data management system for the smart grid. On this basis, the Bagging algorithm is used to train and learn the data samples, construct multiple decision tree configurations, determine the nodes and branches of the decision tree, and finally construct a complete set of random forest algorithm models, and use them to reduce the dimensionality of data. The research results of this project will greatly reduce the difficulty of processing big data, improve the efficiency of data processing, and provide a strong guarantee for the healthy and orderly operation of smart grid.

articleTitle: Development and design of a data acquisition device for cold standby power meter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The cold standby watt-hour meter data acquisition device realizes the data acquisition problem between the cold standby watt-hour meter and the negative control terminal through its own collection and storage function. It transmits the required data to the information platform of the power acquisition system, makes data quantification and comparison through the platform, and uses the big data analysis function to monitor the power consumption information, ensuring the safe and orderly power consumption of customers, improving power supply quality and customer service satisfaction of power supply enterprises.

articleTitle: A Fast Identification Method for Morchella Growth Stage Based on Vision Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: We introduce a rapid identification method for morchella. Based on the unique biological characteristics and growth environmental requirements of morchella, the efficient and accurate identification of key growth stages of morchella is achieved through the integration of information acquisition technology. In order to further improve recognition accuracy, the Multi Stage Vision Enhanced Position Encoding Vision Transformer (MS-EP ViT) model is adopted. By introducing multi-stage input embedding, enhanced position encoding, and optimized Transformer Encoder layers, the performance of the model in identifying different growth stages of Morchella mushrooms is significantly improved. The experimental results show that the model has achieved significant improvements in recognition accuracy and stability, and the rationality of hyperparameter settings has been verified through convergence and parameter sensitivity experiments. Overall, we provide a more accurate and efficient identification method for monitoring the growth of Morchella, which helps to better understand the growth of Morchella and provides scientific basis for optimizing its growth environment.

articleTitle: Anchor-Free Ranking-Based Localization Optimized Siamese RGB-T Object Tracking Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The fast tracking speed of Siamese-based RGB-T tracking has garnered significant attention. However, current Siamese-based RGB-T trackers still face certain limitations, including insufficient bounding box estimation, neglecting the interaction between positive and negative samples, and the complexity associated with adjusting anchors hyperparameters. To address these challenges, a novel anchor-free ranking-based localization optimized Siamese RGB-T tracking network is proposed. Firstly, to enhance bounding box estimation accuracy, a boundary localization optimization module (BLOM) is proposed to optimize the bounding boxes of the visible and thermal infrared (TIR) branches. Subsequently, a fully convolutional anchor-free RGB-T tracking network is proposed to avoid tricky hyperparameter tuning of anchors and to minimize human intervention. Finally, to improve the collaborative learning between positive and negative samples and to eliminate any mismatch between classification and localization, the ranking-based optimization algorithms (RAR) is devised. Extensive experiments conducted on two RGB-T benchmark datasets, which conclusively validates the effectiveness of our proposed network, showcasing the outstanding performance of the proposed tracker.

articleTitle: Research on Packet Loss Rate Measurement Method and Device Realization for TSN Network in Heavy Load Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper outlines the time sensitive network architecture and key technologies, including time synchronization, traffic scheduling, network configuration, etc. This paper proposes a method and device implementation for measuring the packet loss rate of TSN networks in high load environments, provides a measurement architecture diagram, elaborates on the composition and implementation of each module of the device, and provides a calculation method. This method can be used to solve the measurement of lost data packets in industrial control networks using TSN technology, which can help better leverage the real-time advantages of TSN networks. It is of great significance for promoting TSN network applications and deployments.

articleTitle: New Energy used Car Residual Value Prediction Method Based on GBDT Model + Computer Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Accurate prediction of the residual value of used new energy vehicles is crucial for the healthy development of the used car market. This paper first builds calculation indicators based on big data crawling technology. Subsequently, it simplifies the calculation indicators based on the distribution of data and the relationships between indicators. Then, leveraging the advantages of GBDT models, a model is trained using the simplified indicators for predicting the residual value of used new energy vehicles. Finally, the trained model, along with initialized parameters, is applied to predict the test dataset, achieving an average prediction accuracy of 96.6%, effectively meeting industry development needs. This paper provides the used new energy vehicle industry with a high-accuracy, robust model, and theoretical approach for calculating residual values, promoting the industry's high-quality development.

articleTitle: Design of a Vehicle Trajectory Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the increasing advancement of science and technology, the popularity of automobiles in my country has gradually increased. It's not difficult to realize that our daily life and productions tend to be autonomous and not only that autonomous vehicles are not strange to us. Although completely autonomous driving which is the top level of self-driving is still far from us. Partially self-driving or driving assistance is much nearer to our life. Self-driving car has been facing many problems, like the study of machine learning and artificial intelligence not being perfect firstly. And the algorithms still need to be improved. Besides, the complexity of traffic environment adds the difficulties to it. Secondly, when it comes to deployment, the computing power on a single vehicle is not enough to deal with the predicting tasks and the laws and policies are not mature. Especially at the moral level, it's hard for people to fully accept self-driving. For the prediction of vehicle trajectories, it's the key to recognize the driving intention and lane changing prediction means a lot to it. And this paper is mainly on the prediction of lane changing. Deep learning is deeper and has stronger ability to express than usual machine learning, which is getting more popular in most areas. And the recurrent neural network is good at dealing with time sequences problem and has a great contribution to machine translation. While the gradient problems put limits on the RNN especially when dealing with longer sequences. Therefore, the LSTM is proposed to solve gradient obstacles and has great performance on predicting tasks. Based on the existing basics, the LSTM buy in the door control unit to better learn historical information and productivity, performance gets optimized with the attention mechanism. We proposes a LSTM encoder decoder based model and uses social pooling to gain more information about surrounding vehicles. After knowing about some data sets, we finally choose the open data set NGSM and its US-101 and I–80 data.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Software Upgrade for Special Vehicles Based on OTA Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the development of informatization, intelligence, and networking, software-defined technology has become the core driving force for the coordinated development of special vehicle systems. The development towards intelligence and unmanned systems imposes stricter requirements on software, while issues such as the complexity of software systems in special vehicles, short software iteration cycles, and frequent software updates are becoming increasingly prominent. The traditional contact-based soft upgrade imposes an immense workload on software maintenance personnel, resulting in low software upgrade efficiency. This inconveniences the use and maintenance of equipment and reduces its availability. This paper focuses on the equipment usage scenarios, combined with the equipment's information architecture and software architecture, and studies the implementation of OTA technology in special vehicles under the cloud-based collaborative architecture to improve software upgrade efficiency and reduce software maintenance costs.

articleTitle: Residual Value Calculation of New Energy Used Vehicles Based on XGBoost+Feature Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: At present, the new energy used car industry urgently needs a standard method that can accurately calculate the residual value of new energy used cars. This paper first determines the product calculation dimension based on the data from Guazi Website; Secondly, we need to perform data preprocessing such as searching and processing for outliers and missing values in the data source; Once again, we need to perform feature engineering processing such as deleting, merging, and reorganizing data dimensions; Finally, the XGBOOST model was used to calculate the residual value of new energy used cars. The results showed that when the sample size of popular car models was high enough, the model's prediction results could reach over 80%. The model and method proposed in this paper can meet the needs of industry development in calculating popular car models.

articleTitle: Joint Multi-Scale CNN and Vision Transformer for Hyperspectral Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Convolutional neural network (CNN) has shown great performance in the study of hyperspectral image (HSI) classification. However, HSI contains hundreds of continuous spectral bands, and the CNN-based HSI classification methods neglect the deeper sequence semantic information in the spectrum. The spectral sequence information of HSI can be better processed by the Transformer. In this article, a new network MCSS-ViT is designed to cater to vital spectral-spatial features extraction of HSI at different levels. The MCSS-ViT is composed of the multi-scale CNN based on residual and channel attention module (MCRC) with the vision transformer (ViT), where the MCRC involves both the CRC Block and the AIC Block.
