First, principal component analysis (PCA) is employed to reduce the spectral dimension of the HSI. Subsequently, the CRC block is constructed to fully learn the spectral-spatial information of patches. Meanwhile, in order to avoid losing important multi-scale spatial information, the AIC block is developed for capturing complementary spatial features. Finally, the SS-Former is introduced to satisfy the extraction of global and semantic features from the image. The performance of MCSS-ViT was evaluated on two datasets. The conducted experiments showed that the proposed method had better classification effect than other classical methods.

articleTitle: Research on Models Based on Greedy Algorithms, Dynamic Programming Algorithms and Grid Discretization Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This study examines the use of greedy algorithms, dynamic programming algorithms, and lattice discretization algorithms for solving optimal solutions in practical scientific and engineering optimization problems. These three types of algorithms currently play a crucial role in many fields, and can be used to solve various problems such as parameter tuning, finding the optimal solution, and simplify complex real-world problems in order to improve the efficiency of real-world engineering, reduce the use of unnecessary computational resources, shorten the engineering time, and increase the accuracy of classification or measurement of engineering quantities. Greedy algorithms and dynamic programming algorithms solve for the optimal solution inside the feasible solution range. These two algorithms can be based on permutation, combination, iteration, or other strategies, suitable for power scheduling problems, unmanned aerial vehicle path planning problems, and so on. Grid discretization algorithms are mainly used for optimization problems in continuous feasible domains, the optimal solutions in continuous intervals are often difficult to find, while grid discretization algorithms are just able to transform continuous intervals into discrete lattice intervals, so as to find out the optimal solutions of the actual problems, which is applicable to problems such as geological numerical modeling, numerical simulation and analysis of fluids, and so on. The significance of greedy algorithms, dynamic programming algorithms, and grid discretization algorithms in the fields of engineering and science lies in solving complex optimization problems, providing the best decision-making solutions, making the allocation as well as the use of resources more efficient and effective, which can drive the development of science, engineering and other fields. Greedy algorithms, dynamic programming algorithms, and grid discretization algorithms provide important tools and methods for solving real-world problems.

articleTitle: Air Defense Resource Deployment Optimization Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the evolving nature of future warfare, it has become an important research topic to quickly and accurately obtain the optimal resource deployment plan under specific constraints. This paper focuses on the optimization of air defense resource deployment, with coverage rate as the ultimate optimization goal. It adopts the particle swarm optimization algorithm to seek the optimal solution and obtain the best deployment plan. Experimental results show that the intelligent optimization algorithm can obtain a resource deployment plan with a higher coverage rate in a shorter time.

Author Keywords: Optimization of Air Defense Resource Deployment

articleTitle: Application Research of Wireless Sensor Network Technology in Concrete Pavement Quality Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the acceleration of urbanization and the increase of traffic load, the quality and safety of concrete pavement are crucial to the reliability of transportation infrastructure. Traditional pavement monitoring methods are limited by time and space, making it difficult to achieve comprehensive and real-time monitoring of the pavement. This study introduces wireless sensor technology to build a real-time monitoring system, which selects various sensors such as temperature and humidity, pressure, strain, etc. through wireless sensor networks to transmit data in real time to the monitoring center. By analyzing sensor data, it can timely capture temperature and humidity changes and strain of the concrete pavement, so as to detect potential safety hazards in the pavement in time. The research results show that the proposed wireless sensor technology has good real-time performance and accuracy in concrete pavement monitoring. Compared with traditional methods, this technology can more comprehensively evaluate the quality and safety of the pavement, and is expected to provide scientific basis for urban traffic management, reduce maintenance costs, and improve road users' sense of security.

articleTitle: A Trusted Network Framework of Calculation and Storage Separation for Crowdsourcing Property Settlement
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the development of crowdsourcing business, the property settlement through centralized network has been faced with trust problems such as irregular property settlement rules, unclear settlement ownerships, and untraceable settlement processes. Blockchain is a decentralized, tamper-proof, traceable, negotiable distributed network framework. Based on these characteristics of blockchain network and combined with other network calculation and storage technologies such as rule engine, object storage, this paper proposes a trusted network framework for crowdsourcing property settlement with three levels and six modules to meet the requirements of property settlement in automatic processing, visualizing, tracing, confirming and inquiring. Especially for performance and scalability issues caused by participating nodes and data expansion, this paper proposes a network technology of calculation and storage separation. The system of crowdsourcing property settlement was implemented, and the functional verification and performance test were conducted on it. The result shows that the system has high stability and scalability, and can guarantee the trusted management of crowdsourcing property.

articleTitle: A U-Net Based Drivable Region Detection Algorithm for RGB-D Maps
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: To eliminate the influence of poor light conditions during drivable region detection and improve network based road edge contour detection accuracy, RGB-D-U-CRF, aU-Net based drivable region detection algorithm was proposed here in combination with RGB and maps. The proposed algorithm is featured with a dual branch late fusion structure. At different branches, image information of diverse forms was extracted and then subjected to late fusion; and then conditional random fields could be constructed according to RGB-D maps to optimize the boundary of the detected region. It is experimentally demonstrated that RGB-D-U-CRF is capable of performing fine detection of drivable regions in multiple poor light conditions including exposure, reflection and shades in a Cityscapes data set. In comparison with U-Net that merely adopts RGB images, pixel accuracy and intersection over union (IoU) are respectively raised by 5.88% and 6.16%. Besides, the detection time of the proposed algorithm is figured out to be 187ms in this study, signifying a good detection effect.

articleTitle: Low Power Control Strategy of Core Board Based on Hub System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper studies in detail the application of the hub operating system independently developed by Zhixin Company in the power system, and focuses on exploring the effective method of realizing the low power consumption strategy. In view of the key needs of energy saving and emission reduction, equipment life extension and system stability improvement in the power system industry, this paper proposes an innovative power management solution, which is based on the mainstream core board of Zhixin, and significantly reduces the power consumption of the system by optimizing the SoC operating voltage and adopting unique dynamic frequency conversion technology. The experimental results show that in common power system application scenarios, the system operating power consumption can be reduced by more than 20% by adopting the dynamic power management technology and frequency conversion technology proposed in this paper. This research result provides strong technical support for the sustainable development of the power system industry, and helps to promote the development of the power industry in the direction of more energy saving, environmental protection and efficiency.

articleTitle: Intelligent Impact Crater Detection on the Surface of Mars Based on YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Craters are the most typical and widespread topographic features and geological structures on the lunar surface. Real-time crater detection can be used to achieve missions such as autonomous landing, spacecraft and lunar rover navigation. However, due to the complex data distribution, detecting craters is a difficult task, and there are also many small craters in a crater picture. To solve this problem, this paper uses YOLOv7 algorithm, which is currently used in the area of objection detection and use a CNN building block called SPD-Conv to take place the stepwise convolutional layer and each pooling layer. Then a new layer of small target detection is added to the original neural network architecture, and the Wasserstein distance metric is used to help the IOU metric originally used in YOLOv7, reducing the error in small object recognition. Finally, BiFPN is added to YOLOv7 to fuse more scale features. In addition, this study recreated a new dataset to detect small craters. This paper conducted extensive experiments based on this new dataset, and the results have shown a good performance by using this kind of network, especially in detecting the small craters. The recall and precision of this method can get 86.45% and 88.40% respectively, which is better than most detection algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Heliostat Field Design Based on Intelligent Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, a nonlinear goal programming model is established by analyzing the incidence and reflection of solar rays on heliostats. The method comprises the following steps of: calculating a sun altitude angle and an azimuth angle at different times, obtaining a direction vector of a solar ray in a ground coordinate system through angle transformation, obtaining a direction vector of corresponding reflected light rays by traversing position coordinates of different heliostats, and calculating cosine efficiency through an included angle of an incident light ray and a reflected light ray. Based on the ray tracing method of Monte Carlo random simulation, the shadow occlusion efficiency is calculated. A light cone model is established, and the input and output of reflected sunlight energy are replaced by the projected and received areas, and the truncation efficiency is calculated, and finally solving the atmospheric transmittance and obtaining the optical efficiency at different times according to a certain specular reflectance. In order to maximize the average output heat power per unit mirror surface area, the number, size and mounting height of heliostats, as well as the positions of heliostats, are optimized by using differential evolution algorithm. The cosine efficiency, shadow shielding efficiency and truncation efficiency in the optical efficiency are calculated, and the number, position, size, installation height and other parameters of heliostats are searched and solved to maximize the annual average output heat power of unit mirror surface area. The establishment of nonlinear goal programming model to optimize the parameters of heliostat field has certain practical significance and can be used in a wide range of fields.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization System of Machine Learning Algorithm to Improve Wireless Power Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: As wireless power transmission systems are widely used in modern communications, improving their performance and reliability has become an urgent task. However, frequent failures in the system pose challenges to communication quality and reliability. Traditional fault detection methods often rely on rules or manually defined features, which are difficult to cope with complex and changeable actual environments. To address this challenge, this study proposes a novel machine learning model named C-BiLSTM to improve the optimization of wireless power transmission systems. The C-BiLSTM model synergizes features from a convolutional neural network (CNN) and a bidirectional long short-term memory network (BiLSTM). This sophisticated neural network effectively leverages the CNN's adept feature extraction and the BiLSTM's temporal modeling prowess for enhancing wireless power transmission. The transmission signals of the system are used for fault analysis and prediction. Specifically, the model accepts a one-dimensional transmission signal sequence as input, extracts local features through CNN, captures long-term dependencies through BiLSTM, and finally outputs fault classification or prediction results through a fully connected layer to provide a basis for subsequent fault processing. The C-BiLSTM model combines CNN and BiLSTM to accurately predict and analyze faults in wireless power transmission systems. The method of this study not only improves the accuracy of fault prediction, but also reduces the dependence on experts in related fields, which has higher practical significance.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Grid-Connected Contactor Faults in Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The wind turbine grid-connected contactor is one of the important components of the wind turbine, but its failure will affect the actual service life of the wind turbine. Through onsite dismantling of grid-connected contactor equipment with batch failures in wind farms, then we conduct inspection and failure cause analysis. After analysis, the reason for the failure of the grid-connected contactor is that the wind farm is located in the coastal area, and the environment is highly corrosive, which makes the grid-connected contactor susceptible to high salt density and aging quickly. As a result, the dynamic and static contacts of the wind turbine cannot be completely fixed and closed during the grid connection process, and the contacts of the equipment will melt, thereby destroying the grid connection contactor.

articleTitle: Research on the Indicator System of Communication Network of Integrated Electronic System for Aircraft Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The paper presents the framework of a communication network index system for an integrated electronic system designed for aircraft communication. It emphasizes top-level system-level indexes such as high reliability, low latency, high bandwidth, multi-mode communication support, high safety, adaptive intelligent scheduling, and repairability. Additionally, it introduces a downward mapping method for system-level indexes and network-level indexes. The paper also illustrates how this index system can effectively guide the communication network with specific case studies.

articleTitle: Quantitative Assessment of Controllable Distributed Energy Resources in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The active distribution network represents a new trend in the development of power systems, aiming to introduce decentralized resources to enhance the intelligence, flexibility, and sustain ability of the power system. This involves a comprehensive analysis of controllable resources such as thermal power units and energy storage systems to investigate the physical characteristics, unit capacities, response times, and economic differences among various controllable resources. It seeks to clarify the impact of the “dual carbon” policy on the allocation of different resources, and based on empirical system case data, it verifies the economic implications for varying resource capacities under low-carbon policies.

articleTitle: An Optoelectronically Modulated Artificial Bionic Visual Neuron
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The visual perception system is the most important part of the human body to perceive and receive information about the external environment, in which the visual neuron is the basic unit of the visual perception system to achieve the function. As an important part of the bionic neuromimetic perception system, the artificial bionic visual neural system is diligently striving to surmount the computational bottlenecks inherent in the traditional von Neumann architecture. However, structural redundancy and information transmission loss remain a challenge for artificial visual perception systems based on sensor-artificial neuron connections. Here, we propose an artificial bionic visual neuron of sense-storage-computing monolithic type, integrating a light-absorbing layer based on chalcogenide quantum dots and conjugated polymers on top of tantalum oxide artificial neural components, which has good optoelectronic synergistic integration capability. The proposed artificial visual neurons exhibit typical bipolar switching characteristics and integral ignition performance, while showing threshold change behaviour for photomodulation. The unique optoelectronic co-integration ability of the artificial visual neurons can provide assistance for constructing more efficient and low-power artificial visual perception systems, which has a broad application prospect.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of YOLOv8 Model Based on ODConv and SAHI Optimization in Dense Small Target Crowd Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In view of the wide application of dense small target population detection technology in many fields such as traffic management, emergency response, and commercial applications, it is necessary to improve the accuracy and timeliness of relevant models. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a new lightweight and efficient dense small target population detection algorithm based on YOLOv8: ODConv2-YOLO-SAHI. The ODConv dynamic convolution module is embedded into the backbone network of YOLOv8, which enhances the adaptability of the model to the diversity of input data and reduces the computational cost of the model. The ODConv multi-dimensional attention mechanism was introduced to improve the model's ability to extract individual features of small targets by learning complementary attention in multiple dimensions along the kernel space. In the process of model inference, the slicing aided hyper inference mechanism (SAHI) was introduced to improve the small target detection capability of the model. Experimental results show that ODConv2-YOLO with only ODConv dynamic convolution module and ODConv multi-dimensional attention mechanism improves the detection accuracy by 2.1 % compared with YOLOv8n, while the parameter quantity and computational amount are only 2.8M and 7.3GFLOPs; After adding SAHI mechanism, the performance of the ODConv2-YOLO-SAHI model is improved by about 25% compared with YOLOV8n in the average number of detected small target individuals, which better meets the needs of high detection accuracy and low computing power for dense small target crowds in field scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction and Optimization System of Carbon Chain in Load Area of Power System Integrating Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This project studies a PI switch surface sliding mode controller with load frequency changes to solve the problem of optimal control of load frequency in multi-regional networked power grids. A new sliding mode controller based on proportional-integral switching surfaces is used to solve local load disturbances and parameter changes in multi-region networked power grids. This system can effectively reduce the frequency fluctuation of the grid load. The power grid parameters of the two regions are used as mathematical models, and the correctness and robustness of the algorithm are verified by comparing with existing control algorithms. The control strategy proposed by this algorithm can effectively suppress chattering, reduce frequency deviation, and quickly approach 0. This significantly improves system stability. This algorithm can minimize the fluctuation of the load frequency within the specified range and optimize when there are regional load interferences and parameter changes in the power system.

articleTitle: Test Research on the Effect of Peak Cutting and Valley Filling of Distributed Energy Storage Technology in Urban Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper introduces the method of intelligent soft switching technology into the distribution network. This method can not only achieve power complementation on the power supply side, but also improve the overall efficiency device. This project aims to solve the lack of adaptability of traditional energy storage in peak reduction, and studies the problem of peak reduction and valley filling after grid connection of distributed power supply with the background of realizing flexible access of implicit unit in distributed power supply. Two kinds of requirements, namely the smoothness of the power consumption characteristic curve and the performance of improving the voltage, are considered comprehensively to construct the optimization mathematical model of the distribution network. The voltage deviation of distribution network and the load curve change rate of distribution network are reduced to the maximum extent after peak elimination and valley filling. The PSO was modified by MATLAB programming. The modified IEEE-33 distributed power supply scheduling model is used to simulate it. It is found that the energy storage device can be flexibly introduced into the distribution network, which can not only improve the voltage of the distribution network, but also achieve the purpose of peak reduction and valley filling. This algorithm improves the economy and stability of distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on the Driving Capability Evaluation Method Basing on the Parallel Driving System for Automated Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to solve the time cost and safety issues brought by testing the driving capability of drivers in real scenarios, this paper develops a hardware in the loop virtual simulation platform based on the parallel driving system between humans, vehicles, and roads, and realizes the evaluation of the driving capability of virtual drivers. Based on BP neural network, we establish a virtual driver driving capability evaluation model. Combining virtual environment and hardware in the loop system for verification, the experimental results show that the virtual vehicle controlled by the virtual driver model and the real vehicle have synchronization, which verifies the effectiveness of the parallel driving system among humans, vehicles, and roads. The virtual driver driving capability evaluation model has high identification accuracy and can accurately output the results of virtual driver driving capability evaluation.

articleTitle: Hydraulic-Based Rotary Electromagnetic Energy Harvester for Road Speed Bumps
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Vehicles dissipate kinetic and potential energy over speed bumps. This wasted energy has immense potential for powering wireless sensor networks and intelligent transportation terminals. A hydraulic-based rotary electromagnetic energy harvester for road speed bump is proposed to recycle this mechanical energy. The vertical force from the vehicle passing over a speed bump is converted into horizontal motion through the transmission mechanism. And the fluid within the hydraulic cylinder is driven by the transmission mechanism to flow cyclically in the pipeline. Impeller of the electromagnetic generator is rotated by the high-speed flow of fluid, thereby generating electrical energy that can be stored in super capacity. Compact design is adapted to effectively utilize the internal spatial characteristics of the speed bump and minimizes damage to the road surface. An experimental testing was introduced using motor-controlled equipment to investigate the effects of different loading speeds and device pipe diameters on the output energy of the energy harvester. The optimum load for the harvester was determined to be 280 ohms at a rocker loading speed of 21 r/min, resulting in an output power of 0.35W.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of ASCII Extended Character Password Input Module Based on Java GUI
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper presents a Java Graphical User Interface (GUI)-based password management system designed to improve the security and complexity of user passwords. Traditional passwords include only 32 to 128 bits of the ASCII character set, and users cannot enter special characters as passwords. To solve this problem, we designed a program that can listen to the special characters generated by the user pressing the ALT plus numeric keypad combination on the keyboard and convert them into hexadecimal form for display. In addition, the program can store the password entered by the user in a database and match it with the stored passphrase to verify the correctness of the password. By introducing special characters and hexadecimal representation, we have improved the security of passwords and enhanced the management and security of user passwords by managing them in a database [1].

articleTitle: Application of Deep Learning in Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearings Under Variable Operating Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Rolling bearing supports the rotating shaft and the parts on the shaft, and fault diagnosis of bearings driven by big data is an important means to ensure the safe operation of equipment. In response to the increasing complexity of vibration signals in rolling bearings under variable operating conditions and the entry of mechanical fault diagnosis into the “big data era”, the fault diagnosis method based on signal processing is inadequate. This paper applies deep learning to fault diagnosis of rolling bearings under variable operating conditions, constructs a deep convolutional neural network model with small convolutional kernels, applies experimental data of rolling bearings under variable operating conditions to construct variable domain signal datasets, and trains network models with the same structure. Three types of datasets were used to train deep learning network models with the same structure, and the trained models were tested on the test dataset. The results showed that the small convolutional kernel convolutional neural network trained directly on the vibration signal dataset had a fault diagnosis accuracy of up to 100%. This network has good stability and achieves end-to-end fault diagnosis of variable working condition rolling bearings in the era of big data, it overcomes the drawbacks of traditional machine learning, which relies on feature engineering and has low efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: Invisible Fingerprint-based Copyright Protection for Generated Medical Image
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In the recent years, the development of generative models has stimulated the health care progress, specially medical image generation. The synthetic medical images can be applied to several fields and have many utilization, such as data aug- mentation for model training. However, this might lead to the significant copyright issues. Firstly, the data for model training may be the privacy data belong to individuals. Secondly, owners of well-trained model may have burden computation cost. Both of these two stakeholders are not will to share model to others without any compensation or the risk of the image abuse. In order to protect the copyright of the generative model for medical image and reduce the risk of the image abuse, we propose Copyright Protection mechanism for Generated Medical Image (CP4GMI) by inducing invisible fingerprint. In other words, the generated medical image should have the unique fingerprint belong to the corresponding generative model, which can be examined when image abuse happens. Numerous experiments conducted on different medical image datasets shows that our approach can track the generative model in a high-accuracy level when the fingerprint in the generated image is mostly invisible. From the perspective of users and model inventors, we propose a copyright protection mechanism that introduces invisible fingerprints, which can be printed on the generated medical images, and can be used to protect the rights when the copyright is threatened.

articleTitle: An Amplifier for High-Precision Current Detection Circuit
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to improve the detection accuracy of weak current signal, a rail-to-rail operational amplifier with low-offset and low-noise was designed. Two parallel amplifier channels formed an offset-stabilized structure. The gain of the secondary channel was higher, which could effectively suppress the offset of the main channel, and suppressed its own offset by chopping. The main channel compensated for the bandwidth limitation caused by chopper modulation on the secondary channel. After chopper demodulation, a switched capacitor notch filter was used to filter the ripple at the chopper frequency and its multiples effectively. A complementary difference pair biased in the subthreshold region and a Class-AB output stage were used to achieve the rail-to-rail input and output range and reduce power consumption. It was fabricated with 0.18 μm BCD process. The post-simulation results show that the standard deviation of the input offset voltage is 1.1 μV, the equivalent input noise is 16.3 nV/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup> and the open-loop gain is 187 dB. The quiescent current is 67 μA when the supply voltage is 3.3 V.

articleTitle: Camouflaged Animal Target Detection Algorithm Based on YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: It is not easy to quickly distinguish mimetic camouflaged animals by human eyes. The YOLO series of algorithms in the field of deep learning can be used to quickly detect camouflaged animal targets in an image. This thesis use dataset that downloaded and integrated from the official YOLV8 dataset websiteto train the model based on YOLOv5 and YOLOv8. The experimental results show that the mAP value of YOLOv5 is 84.77%, and YOLOv8's mAP value is 81.05%. The two trained models are also applied to detect camouflage animals in Changbai Mountain area, and the detection results are evaluated and analyzed. The detection effects of the trained YOLOv5 and YOLOv8 models are also compared and analyzed to provide some references for the future camouflage animal target detection field.

Author Keywords: Camouflaged animals in the Changbai Mountain region

articleTitle: Practice and Evaluation of Optimal Dynamic Characteristic Response Design Scheme in Nuclear Power Excitation System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The basic structure of excitation system in nuclear power plant and the channel configuration of excitation regulator are introduced. The basic structure of excitation control in nuclear power plant is described. This paper analyzes in detail the problem of system jump caused by the failure of the power supply circuit of the transmitter in the 6800-excitation regulating device of a nuclear power plant. Dynamic and transient stability of the power network, through the test results and practical use of the unit before and after modification, it shows that the optimization of power supply circuit is reasonable and feasible. It can make each path in the excitation regulator independent of each other. In the excitation system, when a power supply line fails, it can automatically supply power to the backup line. Therefore, the reliability of generator excitation system can be further improved to ensure the safety and stability of nuclear power plant.

articleTitle: Bearing-only Passive Location Model of UAV Based on Northern Goshawk Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, through the establishment of effective positioning model and circular UAV adjustment model, the influence of increasing the number of transmitted signal UAV on the effective positioning rate and UAV position adjustment scheme is studied. First of all, in the effective positioning model, through the received angle information, all the feasible solutions are calculated, and the northern goshawk optimization algorithm is used to calculate the optimal solution to obtain the effective positioning rate corresponding to the current increase in the number of UAVs. Secondly, in the circular UAV adjustment model, the on-time UAV, the benchmark UAV and the received angle information are determined, and the adjustment scheme of nine UAV from FY01 to FY09 is obtained by using the northern goshawk optimization algorithm. The research results show that when 5 UAVs are added, the effective positioning can be achieved, and the effective positioning rate is 82.7%. On the other hand, the position adjustment scheme of circular formation UAV requires only two UAV as transmitting signal UAV, and there are only four cases in all angles. These research results have important theoretical significance and practical value for improving the effective positioning rate of UAV system and adjusting the position of UAV.

articleTitle: A Distributed Feature Extraction Method Based on MapReduce
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: For data with complex dimensions, Kernel Principal Component Analysis (KPCA) is a common method of feature extraction, it has a better generalization performance. However, it often face with significant difficulties in computation on large datasets. Therefore, we developed a parallel KPCA algorithm based on MapReduce (MRKPCA) in this paper, it's a parallel computing method which can run in a cluster. We apply our algorithm to an experiment of datasets of face recognition, the experimental results show that our algorithm can scale well and has better timeliness for some specific problems which require a lot of computation, and it can significantly reduce computation time.

articleTitle: Optimization Study of Multibeam Bathymetric System Based on Computer Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Due to the limitation of traditional measurement technology in the actual measurement process, this paper aims at the calculation problems of seabed depth, coverage width and overlap rate in multi-beam sounding technology, and carries out relevant mathematical modeling with matlab technology. First, we defined the Angle between submarine slope and water plane, the opening Angle of multi-beam transducer, seawater depth, coverage width and overlap rate, and established the functional relationship between seawater depth and coverage width. The variation characteristics of seafloor depth, coverage width and overlap rate are analyzed, and relevant mathematical models such as <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$h=h_0-L \tan \alpha$</tex> are established. For the shortest line problem, the influence of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta$</tex> value on the coverage width and line spacing is considered, and the optimal line configuration is calculated. Finally, the main line direction in the east-west direction is optimized to reduce the total line length and control the overlap rate. The percentage of the missing area and the total line length are calculated, where the overlap rate distribution is symmetric about <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\displaystyle \beta=\frac{\pi}{2}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta=\pi, \beta\in [90^{o},\ 100^{o}]$</tex>. The purpose of this paper is to provide theoretical basis and practical guidance for the line design of multi-beam sounding technology, so as to improve the measurement efficiency and accuracy, and expand the practical application ability of multi-beam sounding technology.

articleTitle: Detecting Drowsiness Based on Opencv and Openmv
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to maintain the health of many children who do not have enough sleep time or who are still studying in extreme fatigue, it is important to pay attention to their physical health. This paper proposes a method for detecting drowsiness that combines Opencv and Openmv. Firstly, the model is established and analyzed using haar facial recognition training and dataset sampling when a person is feeling drowsy. Then, dlib facial feature extraction is used to obtain coordinates, and the algorithm is used to calculate the aspect ratio of the eyes and mouth. Finally, a threshold is used to determine drowsiness and fatigue, and more scientifically, the degree of fatigue in children is detected based on their daily routine.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Beam Survey Line Layout Model Based on Single-Objective Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The design of traditional multi-beam survey line technology can no longer meet people's needs for high-precision seabed terrain layout. Traditional algorithms and models have limitations in measurement accuracy. This paper studies key issues in multi-beam bathymetry systems and achieves high accuracy and full coverage of seafloor topographic data by increasing the number of beams. Through in-depth research on issues such as coverage width, overlap rate, and survey line layout, this paper determines key indicators such as seawater depth, transducer opening angle, and distance from the measuring line to the center point, and establishes algebraic equations. Taking into account geometric relationships and constraints, single-objective optimization is achieved, and the final model complies with the regulations in the Hydrographic Code (GB12327-2022). The research results emphasize the influence of seawater depth on the coverage width of survey lines and demonstrate the topographic characteristics under different survey line directions.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Culture Digital Computer Display System Driven by Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The intangible cultural heritage represented by sound, image and craft has very limited ways to present and publicize to the public through digital technology. The introduction of body perception in the digital interaction of intangible cultural heritage can further enrich its expression and enhance users' enthusiasm for participation. This project intends to carry out the research on digital display and interaction of human movement characteristics based on Kinect and Leap Motion. The material of cultural relics was processed by using normal mapping technique. This project extends from two-dimensional to three-dimensional human-computer interaction scenes, and makes the actions and states in human-computer interaction process work cooperatively with those in virtual scenes. Two modes of “rotation” and “choose-motion-release” are established to achieve the purpose of human-computer interaction,. Compared with the traditional interaction technology based on mouse, keyboard and touch screen, this interaction technology of motion sensing and gesture recognition is more natural and convenient. The multi-modal sensor interactive reproduction technology studied in this project can efficiently reproduce various types of digital heritage, especially three-dimensional cultural relics.

articleTitle: Key Section Search Method Based on Key Branches
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The determination and online monitoring of key sections in the power grid are of great significance for the safe and stable operation of the power system. In order to more effectively search for key sections, this paper proposes a method for searching key sections based on key branches. Compared with traditional algorithms that search for key branches based on safety margin, this method searches for key branches based on active power abnormal behavior, greatly reducing the algorithm's time complexity. To adapt to engineering practice, traditional cut-set algorithms for searching key sections are improved to accommodate non-connected power networks. At the same time, the searched key sections are graded, and the monitoring range of key sections is flexibly adjusted according to the budget, realizing effective monitoring of the power grid. Simulation results show that the key sections searched by this algorithm not only include the key sections given by experts in power grid operation modes but also discover new key sections.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation and Route Optimization of Shipping Vessels Based on Intelligent Scheduling Algorithm and Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In the current era of globalization, import and export trade is closely related to shipping, and routes across major rivers and even oceans are constantly being developed to transport the materials needed by different countries and regions. These shipping transportation not only meet the needs of various places, but also bring practitioners a lot of income, but in order to further improve the efficiency of transportation, reasonable allocation of ship resources and transportation routes are the main research direction. Therefore, in order to meet this demand, this paper proposes to use intelligent scheduling model to solve scheduling and path planning problems, and the model needs to use NSGA-II (Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II, a multi-objective optimization algorithm) to carry out. Finally, through the comparative experiment of transportation time, the average transportation time of intelligent scheduling system is 11.89h, while the average transportation time of basic scheduling system is as high as 15.10h. By comparing with the basic scheduling system, this paper finds that the scheduling system based on intelligent scheduling algorithm can significantly reduce the transportation time and improve the transportation efficiency.

articleTitle: Thermal Analysis and Heat Dissipation Design of Inter-UAV Fleet Modular Laser Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: For the requirements of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) formation for safety, concealment, anti-electromagnetic interference and information interaction, an array multi-point laser communication scheme is proposed and the modular design idea is used to establish the optical space division multiple access (SDMA) wireless laser communication network between UAV fleets. For heat dissipation of laser devices on modular laser communication terminal, simulated analysis is done for the arrangement mode, temperature range and other aspects of laser devices through establishing the thermal coupling model of laser devices in working. In order to solve the problem of heat dissipation, a single-fan double-fin heat dissipation method is raised. By conducting thermal model analysis using Flotherm and verifying it experimentally, the results show that when ambient temperature is not higher than 40°C, this method is proved to be capable of significantly reducing the temperature rise of laser devices and satisfying the temperature requirements of laser devices.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of GABP Neural Network Algorithm Model in Computer Network Security Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Network security is an important issue facing current network security. This project takes the traditional BP neural network as the research object and network security factors as the research object. It uses the global optimization function of the genetic algorithm to build a nonlinear model of network security factors, expands its scope of application, and improves the generalization ability of the neural network. This paper provides theoretical basis for the assessment and prediction of network risks and network security situations. Through case analysis, it is proved that the method of using GABP neural network for network security evaluation and forecasting can maintain the overall security comprehensive level of the network at a very high situation value level, and provide an effective method for network security early warning and management.

articleTitle: Intelligent Recommendation Algorithm Based on Multi-Service Power Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Electric power companies often need to deal with a large amount of data, which are stored in the data centre stage is extremely dispersed, and the problem of difficult to fetch and use the data arises. This paper proposes an intelligent recommendation algorithm based on electric power data. Firstly, based on the constructed business logic relationship mapping, this paper calculates the similarity between the business demand information and data content, carry out correlation analysis on cross-departmental and cross-professional data, and obtain the data collection of the department where the business demand is located and the associated departments. Then this paper optimizes the intelligent recommendation algorithm based on deep neural network, pays attention to the implicit relationship between the data through the introduction of the attention mechanism to get the data collection associated with the exact business demand. Finally, it realises the intelligent extension of data fields for different business needs and provides intelligent recommendation for data with different business needs. The experimental results show that the algorithm has better intelligent recommendation performance, higher precision and superior efficiency. The method can intelligently recommend associated business data, and help users in the power problem scenario to obtain relevant information quickly and accurately, which has certain practicability and popularization value.

articleTitle: Research on Graph Data Classification Algorithm Based on Deep Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, the widespread application of graph data in various fields has increasingly highlighted its importance. Social networks, bioinformatics, knowledge graphs and other fields are all inseparable from the processing and analysis of graph data. The classification task of graph data is a key part of the in-depth exploration and understanding of these complex relationships. In this context, the rise of deep learning technology has brought new ideas and methods to graph data classification. Deep learning technology, with its powerful feature extraction and pattern recognition capabilities, has demonstrated excellent performance in fields such as images, speech, and natural language. Based on this cutting-edge technology, this paper conducts an in-depth study of graph data classification algorithms based on deep learning technology, focusing on two key aspects: attention network and cost sensitivity. In terms of attention network, we adopt the Graph Attention Network (GAT) as a feature extraction tool for graph data. GAT simulates the human attention mechanism and can dynamically allocate weights to highlight important information while suppressing irrelevant information, thereby better capturing the structure and attribute information of graph data. On the other hand, cost-sensitive techniques are learning methods that take into account the different costs of different classification errors. In this paper, we adopt cost-sensitive graph neural network (CS-GNN) as a classification tool for graph data. CS-GNN can dynamically adjust the loss function and gradient descent direction according to different categories and error costs to improve classification efficiency and accuracy. To sum up, this article's research on graph data classification algorithm based on deep learning technology provides important ideas and methods for the analysis and mining of graph data. These results are not only expected to promote the development of graph data classification algorithms in the academic field, but will also play an important role in practical applications and promote scientific and technological progress and innovative development in various fields.

articleTitle: Research on Spatiotemporal Data Restoration and Power Prediction Model of Electric Carbon Green Energy Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the gradual development and application of new energy sources, the establishment of new energy power plants challenges the spatiotemporal data monitoring of new energy sources. Due to the inability to obtain accurate spatiotemporal data, there are still big problems in the power prediction of new energy generation. With the aid of artificial intelligence for intelligent monitoring, this paper finds out the abnormal points from the real-time data of space and time, and for automatic correction, it then improves the energy application structure.

articleTitle: A Method for Predicting Coherent Acoustic Field of Substation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In view of the fact that the existing method for predicting coherent acoustic field of substation do not effectively consider the real source intensity and coherence between the sound sources, a new method for predicting the acoustic field of substation is established in this paper. Firstly, the field prediction model is established based on the equivalent idea, and the corresponding optimization mathematical model is established with the goal of minimizing the mean square error between the measured sound pressure of the typical measuring point and the predicted sound pressure of the model. The nonlinear least square method is used to solve the problem, and the equivalent sound source coordinates and complex source intensity are obtained. On this basis, the obtained equivalent sound source coordinates and complex source intensity are substituted into the acoustic field prediction model to achieve accurate prediction of complex acoustic field.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Remote Control System of Fire Alarm Controller Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of high cost and cumbersome installation for remote operation of fire alarm controller control function in existing remote fire monitoring system, a remote control system of fire alarm controller based on STM32 is designed. The system consists of data acquisition, command control and data processing platform of upper computer. The lower computer uses STM32 as the primary controller, and realizes the information collection, processing and function control of fire alarm controller through 4G communication technology, isolation control module and information acquisition module. The host computer uses python as the development language to design the intelligent classification model of fire alarm controllers and the exploration model of the fire alarm controller control instruction, and realizes the functions of fire alarm controller type classification and the exploration generation of fire alarm controller remote control instruction. The test results show that the model classification of fire alarm controllers, the generation of control instructions and the function control of fire alarm controllers have achieved ideal results, and the event processing efficiency has been improved to a certain extent, which has great practical significance.

articleTitle: Construction and Evaluation of a Multivariate Prediction Model for Educational Expenditure in China
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This research aims to construct and evaluate an innovative multivariate model for predicting China's education expenditure. In the model, we comprehensively consider several important variables such as population size, resident income, the number of educational institutions, the number of students, the number of teachers, and regional GDP. In particular, we employ the gradient boosting method and optimize it to enhance the model's predictive accuracy and generalization ability. Our model is described with detailed mathematical proofs and pseudocode algorithms to ensure its theoretical soundness and practicality. Experimental results demonstrate that, compared to traditional prediction models, our model performs better in terms of prediction accuracy and stability. The findings of this study not only provide strong technical support for the rational allocation and utilization of education funds but also offer an effective solution for similar prediction problems.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Translation System Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at the practical needs and challenges of bilingual translation, this paper discusses how to apply artificial intelligence algorithm to online translation in order to build an efficient and accurate intelligent translation system. Taking Chinese-French translation as an example, this study first analyzes the current problems in the field of Chinese-French translation, such as semantic information loss caused by cultural differences and translation deviation caused by sentence structure complexity, and clearly points out the great potential of artificial intelligence technology in solving these problems. On this basis, the application principles and implementation strategies of commonly used artificial intelligence algorithms in intelligent translation systems are introduced in detail. By integrating these advanced technologies, a Chinese-French intelligent translation system with self-learning and optimization capabilities is designed and developed. This system can not only accurately translate words and phrases, but also understand and process complex syntactic structures to a certain extent, and effectively retain the cultural connotation and contextual information of the original text. The empirical study shows that with the aid of artificial intelligence algorithm, the intelligent translation system developed by us has significantly improved the translation quality and stability in the Sino-French mutual translation task. This provides an important theoretical basis and technical support for further optimization and improvement of intelligent translation technology, especially for cross-language communication between China and France.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Management Strategy for Electric Vehicles Based on Flywheel Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the development of electric vehicles, their economy has become one of the research hotspots. A braking energy recovery system for electric vehicles based on flywheel energy storage was designed, and a vehicle economy model for flywheel energy storage was established on the Cruise platform. A control strategy for the flywheel braking recovery system was designed and verified through simulation. The results indicate that, in addition, compared to energy storage systems without the flywheel, the integration of flywheel energy storage control strategies helps to reduce power battery consumption by 0.64%. In addition, the use of flywheel energy storage strategy can recover 2704.62 kJ of energy, which contributes to a 15.43% increase in driving range within the discharge depth range of 70% to 50%, significantly improving the overall driving range of the vehicle.

articleTitle: Research on Vegetable Sales Strategies of Supermarkets Based on Time Series Analysis and Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper conducts a comprehensive study on the replenishment and pricing problems in the sales of vegetables in supermarkets, utilizing models such as neural networks, particle swarm algorithms, and multi-objective planning to establish a replenishment and pricing strategy based on the historical transaction information, and puts forward the suggestion of collecting more data. Firstly, the distribution pattern and correlation of sales volume of vegetable categories and individual products are analyzed, and the sales volume distribution graph is drawn through monthly data and the significance test is conducted by using Pearson's correlation coefficient and Spearman's correlation coefficient. Next, the relationship between total sales volume and cost-plus pricing is studied, and the relationship is determined through scatter plot and regression analysis, it is finally found that there is no significant relationship between total sales volume and cost-plus pricing. Next, neural network and ARIMA algorithms were used to predict the sales volume and price of the vegetable category in the coming week, and the particle swarm algorithm was applied to solve the optimization model, and the optimal solution for the revenue was obtained as $2,408.5. Finally, a multi-objective particle swarm algorithm is used to optimize the selection of saleable individual products to ensure that the market demand is met while maximizing the revenue of the superstore. In addition, this study suggests collecting more data from multiple sources to improve the accuracy and applicability of the model.

articleTitle: Spread Spectrum Signal Detection Method Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Direct Sequence Spread Spectrum (DSSS) is more susceptible to noise, and cannot effectively identify the information. In order to effectively identify spread spectrum signals and conventional signals, a method based on quadratic power spectrum is proposed. Firstly, the standard deviation of the normalized secondary power spectrum of the spread spectrum signal and the conventional signal is solved, the signal is identified according to the standard deviation, and then repeated experiments are carried out on a large number of signals. Finally, all the training signals are brought into the support vector machine for training. According to the obtained support vector machine model, the remaining signals are tested, and the accuracy of signal recognition and classification is 99.83 %. The results show that the spread spectrum signal can be detected and identified very effectively.

articleTitle: Method for Sharing Radio Spectrum on Basis of Beam Constant Offset for Low-Orbit Communication Satellite System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper provides a method for sharing a radio spectrum with high-orbit communication satellites, which comprise a geosynchronous satellite and operate in a near-equatorial orbit, based on a beam constant offset, and a low-orbit communication satellite system. The method comprises: low-orbit communication satellites completing, near the South and North Poles and the equator, the conversion of a transmitting beam constant offset state, wherein before and after each implementation, beam offset directions are the opposite of each other, and the beam offset degree is a fixed constant. The low-orbit communication satellites near the equator all deflect towards the equator. During beam offset conversion near the North and South Poles, services are provided by beams of other low-orbit communication satellites in two other orbits, which are adjacent to each other, at both sides of the current orbit. And during the implementation of beam offset conversion near an ascending node and a descending node, beam coverage services are provided by adjacent low-orbit communication satellites located at the other side of the ascending node or the descending node in the same orbit.

articleTitle: Design of Forestry Carbon Sink Measurement and Prediction System Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: To release oxygen and sequester carbon, forests are essential. For Chinese cities to attain carbon neutrality and carbon peak, a precise evaluation of forest carbon storage is important. This work used a prediction system based on convolutional neural networks in the design of a forestry carbon sink measurement and prediction system. Using eastern China's 2020 forest field inventory data as an experimental sample, we investigated the capabilities of deep-learning algorithms such as Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The findings demonstrated that the main factors influencing the estimation of forest carbon density were coherence from Sentinel-l, backscatter and textural features from ALOS-2, and vegetation indices from Sentinel-2. It was also discovered that the CNN model outperformed conventional models. Combining the optical and radar data effectively confirmed the improvements through the results of the forest carbon-density estimation. Deep learning provides a better chance of correctly calculating forest carbon density from multisource remote-sensing data than conventional regression techniques.

articleTitle: Research on Object Recognition Detection Based on Image Processing and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, the application of image processing and machine learning in object recognition is studied. Firstly, a calculation method based on color, size and leaf area ratio is proposed. Through image preprocessing, RGB color extraction, edge detection and other steps, the classification model is trained and predicted. Secondly, a method based on image preprocessing, two-dimensional area calculation and leaf area ratio conversion is proposed to estimate the target quality by calculating the mass distribution histogram. In object recognition, a feature extraction method based on image preprocessing, standardization and convolutional neural network is proposed to train and evaluate deep learning models and realize object recognition.

articleTitle: Parameter Optimization of Active Disturbance Rejection Controller for Precision Fertilizer Machine Based on Estimation of Distribution Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, the Univariate Marginal Distribution Algorithm (UMDA) in estimation of distribution algorithms (EDA) is proposed to optimize the parameters of ADRC for flow control in precision fertilization process. Firstly, the mechanism model of precision fertilizer machine and the parameters of Active Disturbance Rejection Controller (ADRC) based on separation principle are analyzed. Then selected UMDA algorithm to optimize ADRC parameters, Gaussian distribution probability model is established in the optimization process and truncation method is used to make decisions for elite individuals. Finally, through simulation research and analysis, the feasibility and effectiveness of UMDA algorithm for ADRC parameter optimization in precision fertilization process are verified. The controller after parameters optimization has the advantages of strong anti-interference and fast convergence speed.

articleTitle: Design of Application Security Scheme of Electronic Tag Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Research on the use of Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technology, on the basis of meeting the performance requirements such as reading distance, RFID tag chip adds SM7 (SM7 cryptographic algorithm) ciphertext data. The security chip supporting SM1 (SM1 cryptographic algorithm) and SM7 security algorithm is added to the RFID reader/writer, and the cryptographic machine supporting SM1 security algorithm is added to the master station of the asset management system to realize the security protection of assets and data transmission. Through the SM1 and SM7 security algorithm authentication process, operation and maintenance personnel can identify the authenticity of RFID tags, which effectively protects the management data at various stages of planning, procurement, operation and maintenance, and scrapping, avoiding illegal equipment detection to obtain asset information, and preventing information leaks. The experimental results show that the scheme not only has the functions of fast scanning, anti-pollution ability and durability of RFID tags, but also has the function of anti-authenticity and guaranteeing the security of data transmission.

articleTitle: A Study of Wordle Games Based on Mathematical Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This study explores the potential of the daily puzzle game Wordle, as disseminated by The New York Times, as both a leisure activity and an educational tool. Through the analysis of game data shared on Twitter, we develop mathematical models to decode the puzzles and examine player strategies, word selection tendencies, and game difficulty settings, aiming to refine the game's design for an improved user experience. Additionally, we consider Wordle's educational merits, particularly its utility for English vocabulary acquisition. Utilizing a genetic algorithm-based neural network prediction model, we assess player completion times using three-word attribute indicators as input and seven corresponding completion time percentages as output. Employing a 6:2:2 ratio for our sample learning set, training set, and validation set, and selecting five neurons for the hidden layer with Bayesian regularization, we establish an accurate prediction model. We demonstrated its effectiveness by predicting the completion time percentages for the word “EERIE,” achieving an MSE of 21.1049 and an R-value of 0.93095. For word difficulty classification, we employed KMeans++ clustering analysis, considering parts of speech, letter repetition, and frequency of common letters in the word. Using the elbow rule, we categorized words into three difficulty levels. Our analysis yielded 114 medium, 107 hard, and 138 easy words, with the word “EERIE” classified as easy. The model's performance, indicated by a silhouette coefficient of 0.4914, DPI of 1.312, and CH value of 174.187, was robust. Future work will focus on refining the BP neural network model parameters to enhance accuracy, robustness, and generalization, thereby improving predictive outcomes.

Author Keywords: BP Neural Network Prediction Based on Genetic Algorithm

articleTitle: Video Stablelization Based on Grid Wariping and Moving Gaussian Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this article, we propose a method for video stabilization that utilizes grid-based motion extraction and temporal moving Gaussian filtering for smoothing motion. The method determines the parameters for multiple homography estimations using optical flow estimation. Compared to previous methods, it allows for timely adjustment of smoothness and simplifies computational complexity. In experiments, our method is compared with existing 2D and 3D video stabilization techniques. The results indicate that our method approaches the stabilization effectiveness of 2D methods while significantly reducing the computational complexity compared to 3D methods. Furthermore, we find that by fine-tuning parameters such as covariance filtering, homography plane estimation, and the number of motion smoothing iterations, we can further optimize our method to suit various application scenarios.

articleTitle: Optimization of Heliostat Field Layout Using Enhanced Whale Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The heliostat mirror field is an important subsystem of tower-type photovoltaic power plant, in which the layout of heliostat mirror field is a research hotspot in recent years. This paper proposes an optimized layout method of the heliostat field based on the enhanced whale algorithm. Taking the maximization of the annual average output thermal power per unit area as the objective function, a single-objective planning model is established, and a multilevel penalty factor is introduced to achieve better constraints on the objective function. The convergence and effectiveness of the algorithm in solving the problem can be improved by introducing a differential variational perturbation factor in the whale algorithm, and the parameters of each heliostat field in the simulated environment are derived. Finally, through the comparison of various optimization algorithms, it is concluded that the optimized whale algorithm has a better generalization in this kind of problems.

articleTitle: Computer-Generated Image Detection Based on Multi-Scale Feature Fusion Attention Module
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: As processing technology advances rapidly and image editors become widely used, computer-generated (CG) images are becoming increasingly lifelike, making it harder and harder to distinguish them from photographic (PG) images by eye. At the same time, the potential malicious uses of highly realistic computer-generated images have made the detection of the authenticity of digital images an important research field. In this study, we propose a method for detecting computer-generated images that combines multi-scale feature learning and the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM). This method uses a feature transfer module and a feature fusion module, considering both the superficial content features of the image and deeper semantic features, thereby enhancing the recognition ability of computer-generated images. We have validated the efficacy of this method through lots of comparative experiments and comparisons with other models. Experimental results show, our model has good performance in CG image detection.

articleTitle: Deicing Robot Design Based on ANSYS Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative solution to the problem of icing on 10kV transmission lines in China's plateau mountainous area, which is a power line deicing robot equipped with a deicing device by UAV. To achieve this goal, detailed structural design has been carried out on the key components of the deicing robot, including the deicing device, the UAV and the deicing milling cutter. Using SolidWorks, a three-dimensional model of the deicing robot has been successfully built, providing convenience for subsequent simulation and experimental verification. The UAV -based transmission line Deicing robot provides an effective technical means to solve the problem of transmission line icing under the special terrain of plateau mountainous areas in China. Through the structural design and strength analysis of its key components, we have proved that the Deicing robot has high reliability and stability. And we optimize the control system of the Deicing robot, improve its autonomy and adaptability in complex terrain environments, and make greater contributions to ensuring the safe operation of transmission lines in China's plateau and mountainous areas.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Modular Standard Module for Orderly Charging
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the popularity of new energy vehicles, the demand for charging facilities is also increasing. However, the unreasonable use of charging facilities and the safety problems in the charging process have become increasingly prominent. In order to solve these problems, this paper proposes a new energy vehicle charging management system based on orderly charging strategy. The system adopts an orderly charging strategy, and realizes the effective management of the charging process of new energy vehicles through intelligent scheduling and management of charging equipment. Specifically, the system uses a variety of sensors and controllers to monitor the working status of charging equipment and the charging demand of new energy vehicles in real time, and formulate the corresponding charging plan according to the monitoring data. At the same time, the system also uses a safety protection mechanism to ensure the safety of the charging process. The experimental results show that the system can effectively improve the charging efficiency, reduce the energy waste in the charging process, and improve the safety of the charging process.
